Exhausted and desperate to prove he’s just a plain old No-Namer, Han-Yeong blurts out the wildest challenge imaginable… and ends up undressing right in front of him. Regret hits immediately.

“If I could go back in time, I’d never throw out a stupid suggestion like that to this lunatic…”

But now that the line’s been crossed, will fate keep dragging them back together, or was this one outrageous mistake just the beginning?

(Source: Lezhin US)

187178.description:
Hoshiai Ren and Tenmado Yuya are childhood friends and husband and wife. They have an incredibly cute son, Makoto, and the three of them live a dream-like life filled with sweet happiness. However, this life is kept in perfect balance due to a secret that Yuya holds. In fact, Yuya is not an Omega, but an Alpha, and Makoto was born to Yuya's twin brother, Yuuma...

A new dimension of Omegaverse filled with happiness and sadness!

(Source: Libre, translated)

187183.description: A family who gets in way over their heads when the younger sister ends up owing the yakuza money. Since she can't pay, the gang members take her instead to use as a sexual toy. She then enacts gruesome revenge upon her perpetrators.

title.native: 俺の部室がヤリ部屋に！？
title.romaji: Ore no Bushitsu ga Yaribeya ni!?

187185.description:
One day, Wataru stumbles upon a gate that allows travel back and forth between Japan and another world. Beyond the gate is a fantasy-like world.

Seeing a town whose civilization was undeveloped in many respects, he realizes the potential for great profit. In other words, bringing sugar, spices, coffee, hygiene products, and the like to the other world and making a fortune.

Striking it rich in the other world, Wataru suddenly realizes something when he sees a potion for sale: "Maybe this would be better in the other world?" Wataru makes a killing bringing potions that instantly heal the user's wounds to earth. He also buys beautiful slaves, and before long, he is doing great on earth too.
synonyms: Trade Between a Different World and Earth

title.native: 異世界⇔地球間で個人貿易してみた
title.romaji: Isekai⇔Chikyuu-kan de Kojin Boueki Shite Mita

187186.description:
"I want to be the wizard of my dreams!”

Zenith, a young girl reincarnated in the ancient Roman-style country of Jupiter, goes to study in the capital with only her momentum.

She spreads water magic and floods the classroom. She even falls unconscious after using herself as a test subject, and shoots hot air out of her buttocks in an experiment, and her outlandish behavior never stops.

Despite the white eyes of the people around her, she sells shaved ice using ice magic to earn money for her research, and it accidentally becomes a big hit...?

"Amazing! I've made the discovery of the century again!”

Sometimes a catastrophe, sometimes a success(?), sometimes a laugh-out-loud moment!

A Roman comical fantasy of a research-loving girl sparking a magical revolution begins!

(Source: Comic Corona, translated)

Note: Note: Chapter count includes four volume-bonus chapters.

title.native: 転生大魔女の異世界暮らし～古代ローマ風国家で始める魔法研究～@COMIC
title.romaji: Tensei Dai Majo no Isekai Kurashi: Kodai Roma-fuu Kokka de Hajimeru Mahou Kenkyuu - @COMIC

title.native: 触手プレイxアクセッション

187189.description:
One day, after being discovered in an abandoned house by a rescue team, Mori suddenly finds himself in a children's protection center. Here, he begins to learn a new way of life – one that includes grand care packages sent by a mysterious patron. But when his closest friend is reunited with her mother and leaves the center, Mori learns for the first time the existence of a mother for every child, and decides to embark on a journey to find his own. But what sort of obstacles wait along the way?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes 22 extra chapters.

187190.description:
Help! An incubus that died a virgin has possessed me!

Exorcist Palmoon Han gets a call from a man in distress. His new client, Dun-gab, has a few options to free himself from the demon, but none of them seem adequate. To help his client, Palmoon makes Dun-gab an offer he can't turn down. How will this offer help Dun-gab gain freedom from the incubus?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes 9 side story chapters.

title.romaji: Satsuma Tensei: Yo ni Manyou no Maru Juuji ga Sakunari

title.native: センチは続くよどこまでも

187194.description:
"Did that... just move?!"

U-Jin, a totally average engineering student, accidentally buys an onahole that syncs with women around him.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

187195.description:
On the island he arrives at to find his younger brother, he is tempted by women of a suspicious cult.

(Source: DAYcomics)

As someone who has become rich over night, let me tell you why I say money’s beautiful.

(Source: Toomics)

187204.description:
"Tae Seong-Jae... He’s the one who will take me back home."

One day, without warning, I woke up as Seo Seung-Won, a character in a BL novel given to me by my younger sister. The aftermath of being transported into this world is brutal—I’m plagued with relentless nosebleeds, bouts of coughing up blood, and unimaginable pain. I discover that staying calm lessens the torment, so I desperately try to empty my mind and maintain my composure. But as my original memories start slipping away day by day, I spiral into despair. Still, I refuse to lose hope. To escape this nightmare and return to reality, I set my sights on the novel’s ending. Following the story’s flow, I resolve to become Tae Seong-Jae’s lover, face abandonment, and eventually fake my own death—all to achieve my goal of going home.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

187205.description:
Years have passed since omega Prince Ilia was married off to alpha King Khalid of Hanu as a political bargaining chip. But thanks to the years of hardship and chaos they overcame together, this once political union has turned into a genuine, loving marriage. Unfortunately, their peace is soon sundered when Ilia gets word that King Cyril of Romelidahl—the omega-hating father who sold him off—has fallen ill. Having searched his soul for what to do, Ilia hesitantly decides to go pay his respects to the father who betrayed him.

(Source: SuBLime)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Kouguu no Omega: Yukibana no Shou

title.english: Palace of the Omega: A Snowflower’s Tale
title.native: 后宮のオメガ 雪花の章
title.romaji: Kouguu no Omega: Yukihana no Shou

187206.description:
Thanks to his housekeeper-turned-boyfriend, Natsume has finally learned just how enjoyable sex can be and abandoned his misguided plans to get back at his ex. Instead, he’s come up with a new agenda: this time, his goal is to become a lover worthy of his beloved Kou. Yet in the midst of his planning, Kou’s childhood friend Kurumi returns to Japan, and the future of Natsume’s budding relationship is thrown into jeopardy!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: なつめさんは開花びたい

187207.description:
Why are this dating sim's characters into an NPC!?

After being hit by a truck, Tomoya Miyuki wakes up in the world of "Dokimelo High School," a popular dating simulation game. He is the female main character's best friend, who helps her end up with one of the potential matches in the story.
Just when Tomoya's made up his mind to enjoy the kind of high school experience he never had in his previous life, he realizes he's attracted an unusual amount of attention from one of the romance options... the ever-popular Yukito Sakakibara. To top it off, Yukito ends up helping Tomoya remove a capsule item stuck inside him...!
A romantic comedy between a handsome, mysterious otome game character and an average Joe who was supposedly reincarnated as an NPC!

(Source: Renta!)

187208.description:
Ayana Yukihira is a second-year in high school, and after her parents’ divorce, she’s looking for a new start in an apartment of her own. But when she receives the keys, she finds another girl already there—fresh out of the bath! Due to an administrative error, the apartment was also rented out to Yuu Fukami, one of Ayana’s classmates at her new school. But instead of forcing Ayana to find another place to live, Yuu invites Ayana to share the lease as a roommate. As it turns out, the girls also share a mutual attraction that grows with every touch, every passing day…until they’re virtually drowning in it.

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: Watching the Angel Sleep, Drowning in Bed Together

title.romaji: Heaven Burns Red Koushiki 4-Koma - Hebuban Gekijou

187210.description:
Shosuke is a high schooler who’s bad at studying, sports, and almost everything else… But one day, a robot from the future called Chuck Beans shows up to change his life! Sounds like the cliched beginning to a stereotypical story, but Shosuke simply refuses him entry into his house! Tsurun Hatomune presents an offbeat slice-of-life sci-fi gag manga!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

187211.description: A young boy finds himself fascinated by the long hair of the boy in class who sits in front of him.

187213.description: Al is a holy knight, a warrior charged with protecting the innocent from the hordes of ravenous monsters terrorizing the lands. He was, anyway… After being bitten by an undead creature, Al dies–but not for long. Al awakes as an undead, cursed to live an undying life as a mindless monster. However, unlike ordinary undead, for some mysterious reason he retains his mind and sanity. Three hundred years later, flesh rotting off to reveal a living skeleton, Al meets Astrantia. As a descendant of a witch, Astrantia offers to restore his body on one condition: he must agree to become her knight and help her put an end to the unholy curse once and for all. Alongside Astrantia, Al enters an academy for training saints—teams of holy knights and holy women who fight to rid the world of the undead. Al must hide his identity as an undead—the very thing everyone in the school seeks to eradicate—in order for Astrantia to succeed and keep her word. Keeping his secret under wraps proves to be as difficult as hiding his lack of flesh but, if there’s one thing he can’t hide, it’s the strength he’s been honing for the past three hundred years!

187223.description:
Aguri, a girl who has a habit of running away from her jobs, leaves her twentieth part-time job without notice. Aguri wants to change herself, so she decides to put on her shoes starting with her left foot instead of her right. Then she is transported to a different space, where seven versions of herself are waiting for her.

The Aguri who always works part-time, a rapper, a fortune teller, a ghost, a matching app addict, and a distributor—they all wish to return to their respective worlds, too. However, a girl who called herself an “observer” in the different space explained that the space was created due to the fluctuation of the self-identifying of our protagonist Aguri.

(Source: Aokishi, translated)

187229.description:
Yoon Ji-Ha, a struggling actor who’s been dreaming of winning people’s affection for six years, has never even passed an audition. Haunted by a mysterious illness that foretells misfortune, he feels increasingly isolated. But when Song Chae-Heon, a secretive, powerful agency director, offers to make him a star, Ji-Ha is torn on what to do. Despite Chae-Heon’s arrogance, Ji-Ha feels an inexplicable pull toward him. What does Chae-Heon truly want, and why is he fixated on Ji-Ha’s potential?

(Source: Tapas)

187230.description:
Should secrets remain secrets? Or should chaos reign?

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2017-01

187231.description:
Kyuichiro Tachibana loves puzzles! One day, while dreaming of going to a high school with a Quiz Club and enjoying a fun puzzle-solving life with friends, he finds a button for a game. Apparently, this button belonged to his grandfather, who loved puzzles, too. With the button in hand, before he knows it, he is lured into a world that is neither dream nor reality. There, he solves puzzles, earns points, and uses magic! A game of survival unfolds in this strange and mysterious alternate world! What will be Kyuichiro's fate?

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

title.native: 問題だらけの魔法使い

187232.description:
Shirai Ran was just your average nurse in her old world, but after her unfortunate demise, she found herself reincarnated into Sekkakoku—a kingdom where imperial courts hold immense influence.

Now living as Byakuran, she decides to use her memories and modern medical knowledge to cure the sick and injured. However, it's not long before rumors of the "great mender" with incredible powers reach the ears of a certain Prince Kuryu.

In a shocking turn of events, the emperor-to-be snatches her away and gives her an order—become his consort, and cure him of his peculiar illness!

(Source: Manga Up! Global)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra chapter.
synonyms: Die falsche Kurtisane – Heilerin am Kaiserhof

187233.description:
Shirai Ran, an ordinary nurse, lost her life in an earthquake disaster and was reincarnated into an imperial world. There, she used her knowledge of modern medicine to heal the sick, and was revered as a goddess with special powers. The prince of Sekkakoku, Kuryu, who had heard the rumors, kidnaps her to "become my wife and cure me"!? As the potential next emperor, he is suffering from a mysterious illness… However, while she was only meant to be a temporary consort until she cured Kuryu's illness, she was soon overwhelmed by the supposedly cold-hearted prince's naturally doting love!? A reincarnation harem fantasy in which modern medicine is used to heal the ills of the palace.

(Source: Novema, translated)

187234.description:
Hotaruko Nagao is a busy office lady who relieves her stress from work at a host club. Until she falls behind on her credit card payments, and her colleagues find out about it. After getting fired from her job and banned from her favorite host club, Hotaruko suddenly decides to go to… This is the beginning of a realistic slow-life story about a stressed out office worker who starts a new life in a seaside town.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 鎌倉市腰越ふたりぐらし

187235.description:
Ai Ando, 21, works part-time in telephone sales, where she is always the top-performing salesperson! But she earns most of her money through prostitution. All in order to fulfill a dream...

One day, Ai meets Hino, another woman who works at her office who dreams of becoming a writer.

Gradually, they grow closer, but Hino's distorted feelings for Ai begin to destroy her life...

(Source: Young King BULL, translated)

187237.description:
I bought clothes at a shopping mall and got a model?! A warm, everyday romance webtoon about the everyday life of an ordinary office worker, An Gyeong-Jin, and a shopping mall model, So-Hui, who live together!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

187238.description:
In order to help the nine-tailed fox find the elixir of life, the fox demon 'Seoyo' sneaks into the palace. But who appears in front of Seoyo, who was wandering around looking for the magical herb? A girl called 'Elixir of Life'?! Seoyo, curious about the human elixir of life, begins to hover around her, and the two girls begin to open their hearts to each other...

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue

187241.description:
Spring, 1995. Messy-note business major and campus hottie Jinwoo needs someone to rewrite his essays so that they are at least somewhat legible. Perfect-penmanship P.E. major Daehan needs dating lessons so that he can stay in a relationship for at least two weeks. So when the two end up living under the same roof, it seems like the perfect opportunity to help each other out... but after a few fated run-ins, it might be more than just skills that they're swapping!

(Source: Lezhin US)

187242.description:
“Death is only the beginning.”

Truer words were never spoken for young Leon von Marbas, the heir to a once-great house of necromancers. Forced to execute his own father by the lord of a rival house, Leon suddenly finds himself the leader of a declining clan under threat from enemies within and without. The only way to restore the glory of his house? Leon must strike a pact with the demon Marbas, the original source of the powerful necromancy that House Marbas was once known for…

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

187243.description:
Hajime secretly had feelings for his classmate Kazuma. But Kazuma has a girlfriend!? He can't say anything as just friends. Then... Kazuma confesses his feelings to Hajime...

"Now we can't go back to being just friends."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

187250.description:
As a child, Han-Joo was cherished and protected by Ki-Won, the man he thought was simply his father’s friend. Ten years later, they reunite and sit down for a long-overdue night of drinks. But in his drunken haze, Ki-Won whispers a truth Han-Joo cannot ignore.

“You and I… we were lovers. In another life.”

Suddenly, the lines between family, fate, and forbidden desire begin to blur. Can Han-Joo and Ki-Won ever go back to the bond they once had, Or will this revelation pull them into a love that defies time itself?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: ギウォンの祀り〜前世でお前と寝たんだ〜

8. Kousoku H: Aruhi no Hokenshitsu (校則えっち　ある日の保健室); COMIC AUN 2024-12

187254.description:
My name is Haesin and I am 21 y.o. My mom runs the flower shop. Although she is 39, she is rather attractive and good-looking. I was stunned and confused when I knew she dates my friend Kim! What should I do?

(Source: Comico, translated)

187255.description:
Seha lives for Alexandrite, her favorite character in a dating sim game. When she learns he dies in other routes, the shock sends her into the game itself as Lady Arianell, a minor side character. Determined to save him, she decides to play the villain and force his romance with the heroine. Her plan seems simple until Alexandrite falls for her instead, his flirtatious brother also takes an interest, and the story veers wildly off-script. Can she save her fave without becoming his downfall?

(Source: WEBTOON)

187258.description:
Over a decade before the events of the manga series, a chance encounter leads professional bodyguard Yukichi Fukuzawa to begrudgingly take an arrogant boy genius named Ranpo Edogawa under his wing. Their first job brings them to a local theater on high alert after receiving a bizarre death threat-a challenge that will require both Ranpo's brains and Fukuzawa's experience. The aftermath spurs Fukuzawa to establish the Armed Detective Agency, an organization that takes on dangerous jobs even the police won't handle!

Plus, get a glimpse of the agency the night before Atsushi Nakajima joined the team!

(Source: Yen Press)

187262.description:
Born as the second son of a villainous duke, Ryuk is a lazy boy with an apathetic attitude. But when he accidentally learns of the disastrous future that awaits him, he scrambles to find a secure marriage and research magic in order to avoid a bad ending for himself. His efforts are supposed to be working towards a peaceful and lazy life, and yet he gets caught up in one mendacious plot after another…!

The road to laziness will be a difficult one…

A magical sabotage fantasy about a powerless prince who just wants to live a lazy life!

(Source: Corona EX, translated)

187263.description:
"If you're going to bother me, go to sleep instead!"

A magical sabotage fantasy in which an apathetic prince has to prevent the overthrow of his kingdom in order to have a “100% comfortable nap”!

187266.description:
Fifth-grader Kakeru's dream for the future is to open the best record shop in Japan. He wants to evangelise the appeal of records, gather friends and create a record club.
However, the start-up does not seem to be a straightforward process. ...... Daring to record in this day and age. Captivated by the retro charm of records, Kakeru and his merry band of friends become addicted to the vinyl swamp...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: レコード大好き小学生カケル

187268.description:
Mitsuro is on the verge of giving up his dream of becoming a novelist.
Maho can't stay away from her lover, whom she was supposed to have broken up with.
A cat dies, and ‘Sensei’ has trouble with his wife.

From reunion to rebirth.
Time begins to move again, as if to regain the part of us that has been lost.
We can't stay a child forever.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

187275.description:
Jigen Oohashi, age twenty-seven, is a self-styled photographer who’s fed up with all things romantic after taking family photos of his married unrequited male crush, Yamada. After having vowed never to fall in love, Jigen attends his big sister Himeko’s wedding, where he meets Amélie Shirogane…and discovers she’s a serial home-wrecker who’s having affairs with both Himeko herself and Yamada! But Himeko has also handed her brother a mysterious camera that she claims “erases sexual desire”?! It’s the anti-romance manga that gives a big ol’ middle finger to “love”!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: 私たちのブルーアワー
戦慄怪奇ファイル コワすぎ【口裂け女捕獲作戦】

Princess Platina, a devoted saint to her kingdom despite enduring cruel mistreatment, receives devastating news—she doesn’t have long to live. Her stepsister seals her fate by ordering her on a harsh pilgrimage to the Holy Land, effectively banishing her from the royal castle. Eisen, a captive knight, is forced to accompany her as both attendant and witness to her death. What will become of their lives on this journey...?

(Source: Manga UP!)

Though Shion openly expresses her doubts and frustrations, Iris transforms into a completely different person once they step into the House…!?

While still adjusting to this twist of fate, the enigmatic Crown Prince Iskan enters the scene with an unsettling proposition: "Take me as yours," he says, "I’ll become your most cherished possession." Between her reputation as a fool and a prince whose motives remain unclear, can Ji-an navigate this complicated new reality?

(Source: WEBTOON)

187363.description:
Listless and going nowhere, Jiwoo finds a flicker of purpose during his late-night shifts at the convenience store in regular customer, Juhee, a confident and captivating college student who treats him with unexpected warmth. But what begins as quiet admiration soon turns electric, as Juhee reveals a teasing, dominant side that awakens something deep in both of them. Caught between submission and desire, Jiwoo is about to discover just how sweet it can be to give in.

(Source: Lezhin US)

187364.description:
Eun-Nam's got it bad for his best friend Ji-Dong's mom. So he throws out a filthy deal. He offers up his own stepmom. That's how their dirty pact begins. Two shameless punks, both plotting to get into each other's mom's pants.

"It's only fair. We swap moms."

(Source: DAYcomics)

187365.description:
A novel sexually transmitted disease is spreading throughout the world. Infection increases women's libido by several dozen fold but causes death in 99% of men. It's a world where "casual sex = death." The protagonist, Sadao Shindo, who has never experienced sex, vows not to have relations with anyone until a vaccine is developed, but he is assailed by the temptations of women...!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)
synonyms: Ambivalent: A World Where Losing Your Virginity Means Death

title.native: アンビバレント～童貞を捨てたら死ぬ世界～
title.romaji: Ambivalent: Dotei wo Sutetara Shinu Sekai

187366.description:
My first love... Reunited... However, she wasn't the girl I thought I knew.

(Source: Toomics)
synonyms: I Want to Get To Know You

187367.description:
In a world where angels walk among humans, friendless high school girl Misora Shiratori has one goal: to receive the gift bestowed upon only the most outstanding angels—a divine halo. That’s why she lives her life with the utmost sincerity and why, together with her beautiful classmate Kanade Agoshi, she decides to join the student council! But her world is turned upside down when she finds it not to be a haven of virtue, but a den of desires so deep and twisted that its seven members are known as the Council of Deadly Sins…

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: Sinful Is the Angel Who Loves

187368.description: A school survival romantic comedy where students risk getting expelled to find the hidden imposter on campus.

title.native: あなた私の何役ですか
title.romaji: Anata Watashi no Naniyaku desu ka

187369.description:
A strong coach challenges her boss, sparking passion and revealing a shocking connection to a past he can’t recall.

(Source: Toomics)

187370.description:
Kian dreamed of building a new life with his girlfriend, but fate had other plans for him.

(Source: Toomics)

187371.description:
Orphaned overnight, a boy is taken in by his parents' best friends. Years later, love and desire blur as he grows closer to them and their daughters.

(Source: Toomics)

187372.description:
The summer of his second year in high school. An ordinary boy with no dreams or goals catches a glimpse of the class beauty’s unexpected side—! A low-key start to a youthful comedy duo, discovered through trial and error.

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

187373.description: A sweet and gentle story of youth, all starting with a lost item.

title.native: 神原くんのおとしもの

187374.description:
Ritsu, an otaku girl who has never been in love, is obsessed with unlucky 2D male characters. One day, she witnesses a cross-dressing boy from her school getting his heart broken. Struck by how unfortunate he seems, Ritsu finds herself unexpectedly drawn to him.

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

title.native: 嘘つきはかわいいのはじまり

187377.description:
The hardworking daughter of a marquess, once overlooked, learns her true value through love. Sophia, the diligent daughter of a marquess, is engaged to the second prince, Delm. Both serve at the Royal Magic Research Institute, but as his fiancee, Sophia is forced to shoulder his work.

When she invents a new form of magic, Delm steals her research and registers it under his own name. When she demands it back, he refuses and even accuses her of lying.

Hailed as a genius, Delm basks in glory while Sophia is cast away. Stripped of her reputation, her laboratory, and her engagement, she returns home in despair.

Then fate takes an unexpected turn as Sophia becomes engaged to Leo Santorina, the prime minister feared as the "Icewolf Chancellor." Yet behind his cold title lies a kind, gentle man. Cherished and supported by him, Sophia begins to bloom, proving her brilliance while the man who betrayed her faces his downfall.

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: The Oppressed Magician and Noble Daughter Is Doted on by the "Icy Wolf Prime Minister"

title.english: The Icewolf Chancellor's Cast Away Conjuror and the Flames of his Devotion
title.native: 虐げられの魔術師令嬢は、『氷狼宰相』様に溺愛される
title.romaji: Shiitagerare no Majutsushi Reijou wa, "Koori Ookami Saishou-sama" ni Dekiai Sareru

187379.description:
Yeon is a powerful gumiho with a distrust for love and an even bigger distrust towards humans, but what will happen when she gets involved with Dong-i, a poor painter who defies all her expectations of human nature? Will Yeon finally get the happy ending she deserves, or will she pay the price for falling in love with a mortal?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Tale of a Fox's Love

187381.description:
After a fatal accident, Sia is transported into a historical drama as the baby princess of a lowly concubine. All she wants is to live peacefully with her new mother, but Sia's strength and intelligence gain her the favor of the crown prince and the king. Soon, she becomes a pawn in the hotly contested selection of the new queen. With the competing head concubines and their sons using her in their race to the throne, can baby Sia save herself from falling prey to this royal charade?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Born as the Daughter of the Lowly Concubine

title.english: The Princess's Guide to a Perfect Life

187385.description:
"I go to places with a lot of death," - said Asakura, a former detective who now runs a missing persons research company. Because her missing husband might be among the corpses.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

187386.description:
Your whole heart will be swallowed up -- Omori Private Academy, where elite beastman alphas attend. Otani Yuu, a human omega, is the only omega scholarship student at this academy. He wears a chastity belt and is used as live bait for the alphas' desires in "Estrus Endurance Training" during his rut ​​season. One day, Mikimoto Shiou, the heir to the lion tribe and dorm supervisor, appears before Yuu...

(Source: MUGENUP, translated)
synonyms: The Lion Lover and the Honey Cage Omega

title.native: 偏愛獅子と、蜜檻のオメガ
title.romaji: Henai Shishi to Mitsuai no Omega

187388.description:
The anime is set in an alternate version of Heian-kyou, the old name of Kyoto and the capital during Japan's Heian era. This alternate version of the city is named Denji Heian-kyou. A delinquent high schooler named Takeru Narehira resides in our world, but after an unfortunate accident, is transported to Denji Heian-kyou.

Here, he immediately meets Tsukimiya, a woman he has seen many times before in his dreams before. Hardly a moment passes after that encounter when Takeru and Tsukimiya encounter an oni monster, and lose their lives.

Takeru awakens, stunned to find himself again at Denji Heian-kyou. He puts together that he has the power to go back in time. Now he resolves to learn this world's version of mystical onmyōjutsu techniques, and become an onmyōji sorcerer to save Tsukimiya.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 欲求不満な人妻が宅配サービスで×××を注文する話
title.romaji: Yokkyuu Fuman na Hitozuma ga Takuhai Service de ××× wo Chuumon Suru Hanashi

title.native: 隣人サンタからの贈り物

187394.description:
Suze and her childhood friend, Lulu, visit the renowned Bianca Aquarium when the latter ends up disappearing without a trace. Determined to find Lulu, Suzu wanders through the fearful aquarium. Suddenly, she is attacked by a mysterious woman who names herself "Retro"...

The only hint to escaping is to become a creature of the aquarium.

title.native: アクアリウムは踊らない
絶倫大家とシングルマザー

187396.description:
“Of course I recognized you. You’re my first love.”

Living a life of being stalked by her first love, Dam Do is visited by her brother’s friend Yun Oh. No longer the boy next door who used to follow her around like a puppy, Yun is now a man, and he acts strangely aloof around her. While Dam has found herself resenting her first love, Yun is secretly quite excited to be around his first love once again. As the two become reacquainted after their time apart, they may be in for a lesson on what love really is.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Oh, the flower that bloomed on the wall

title.english: A Flower Blooms on the Wall

187397.description:
Aya Makino is sick of life as a woman. One day, she finds herself being molested on a train by a pervert, until another woman steps in to help her… who turns out to be a stripper?! From this encounter, she discovers the world of strip dancing, and begins to rethink her body, her sexuality, and the world she lives in.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: ぷにふわエステでゆるあまおしゃせーする？
title.romaji: Punifuwa Esthe de Yuruama Oshasee Suru?

187399.description:
In a cynical world where love has lost its luster, 37-year-old Ha-Yeong Kim is merely a shell of her former self. But in a twist of fate, she’s catapulted back in time, inhabiting the body and vibrant spirit of her 17-year-old self, Seon Kim, and reliving an era of passionate love and limitless potential. Empowered by her knowledge of what’s to come, Seon embarks on a mission to reshape her friends’ destinies. Bouncing between past and present, orchestrating grand changes, Seon begins to discover that altering others’ lives might be the key to rediscovering love, purpose, and the courage to dream again.

(Source: WEBTOON)

187400.description:
Nova is a cheerful girl who lives in the forest alongside monsters, dreaming of receiving the Blessing of the Earth, known as 'Magia'. However, it seems she has a secret— one only the lord of the forest, Cerberus, knows...

Unaware of this hidden truth, Nova spends her days innocently playing and enjoying life in the forest. Thus begins a wonderful story starring a little girl raised by monsters!

(Source: Magcomi, translated)
synonyms: Nova, Little Girl in the Monster Forest
Nova, das Mädchen aus dem Monsterwald

title.english: Nova, Little Girl in the Monster Forest
title.native: 魔物ノ森ノ少女ノヴァ
title.romaji: Mamono no Mori no Shoujo Nova

187401.description:
Bonus chapters that never made it into the main series volumes, behind-the-scene stories and additional information.

This book was self-published by the author with official permission granted from Shueisha.

title.native: 竜と勇者と配達人 私家版
title.romaji: Ryuu to Yuusha to Haitatsunin Shikaban

187405.description:
It's Sui's 20th Birthday! And her boyfriend takes her out to dinner to break up with her. Seeing that she's already out, she'd rather not end her birthday on a sour note and decides to enjoy her first legal drink! ...But it only brings her back to thinking about love and romance. "I want to be loved... desired..." The next day: Sui wakes up at home, but next to her... some gorgeous young man?! A fun romance of dumping, bouncing back, and getting busy!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 青木くんとはお酒が飲めない
title.romaji: Aoki-kun to wa Osake ga Nomenai

187406.description:
At the edge of the universe drifts a solitary vessel. Within its confines, a man serves an "eternal imprisonment." Through the endless passage of time, he becomes the first to create "something" unprecedented in space... Thus begins a tale that shapes the cosmos, crafted by the author of 'The Vertical World,' Kuu Tanaka.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

187407.description:
Welcome to the Village of Cats! When a brother and sister stumble upon this mysterious village, they're greeted by felines... felines everywhere! But after crossing paths with a strange girl, they begin to uncover the village's startling secrets! Don't miss this purr-fect one-shot comedy about a village where ancient traditions and cats collide!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

187408.description:
Yuna suddenly finds herself transferred to the job of secretary to Sunhyung Cha, the managing director of the publishing house where she works. Already finding it hard to understand why she's being made to work for this director who never turns up for work, she falls under his spell and does the stupid thing of... spending a night with him! And who is this Jihoon Lee who's always hanging around her?

(Source: Webtoons, translated)
synonyms: 初めてにしてはよくできました
The Man, the First, the Romantic

187409.description: Yuuko Sasaki and Kunio Tanaka are assigned to caring for the class guppies.
synonyms: Creatures That Travel In The Sky

187410.description:
When Azumi reluctantly attends a mixer, the last thing she expects is to find a man who feels like a dream. Rui, a veterinarian with the grace and charm of a prince, seems like her perfect match. Bonded by their shared passion for animals, the night ends in unexpected passion at a hotel. But as the sun rises, the "Prince" vanishes. To Rui, their night was a fleeting convenience one night stand. Heartbroken and determined to reclaim her dignity, Azumi starts a new chapter at a prestigious clinic, vowing to pour her soul into her work. But fate has a cruel sense of humor: her new colleague is none other than Rui. Now, forced to work side-by-side, Rui issues a stern warning: "Don't fall for me." Yet, the friction between them begins to ignite a romantic fire that can't be easily extinguished.

(Source: CLLENN)

title.native: 俺のこと、好きにならないでね
title.romaji: Ore no Koto, Suki ni Naranaide

187411.description:
After our protagonist helps out a girl dressed as an elf at a doujinshi event, she starts following him around, calling him "Hero-sama." He thought she was just role-laying, but it seems like the girl is actually serious about it… The story about the difficulties of daily life between an amnesiac elf and an ordinary guy!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 私を養って! 勇者さま

187412.description:
Dongmin, a pacifist by nature, must fight to survive against a zombie infestation. Darkness within him slowly awakens.

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Chapter count includes 1 prologue.

187413.description:
While livestreaming about his struggles, Si-Woo receives a donation with a strange request. He agrees, only to discover it came from Limen, the goddess of Eden, who has suddenly tasked him with defending her world from seven demon rulers. Ten years later, Si-Woo returns to Earth as the pope of Eden, only to find it overrun by monsters. The demon rulers show signs of reappearing, and to maintain his divine power, he must spread Limen’s faith across Earth. Can Pope Si-Woo complete his holy mission?

(Source: Tapas)

187414.description:
Yeonu plans to end her secret affair with her boss, but an unexpected twist traps her in a bond she can't escape.

(Source: Toomics)

187415.description:
Transmigrating as the background character Erusha Shablin wouldn’t be so bad if her father, Leonardo, weren’t such a menace. At this rate, the story will play out exactly as written: eviction by her grandfather followed by a tragic death. To avoid her canon ending, Erusha must prove her worth and win her grandfather’s approval—but that would be far easier if he weren't constantly angered by her father's antics. Can she navigate this multi-generational “daddy issues” disaster?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Daughter of a Rogue Successor!

title.native: ごめんね…私…他の男の人と…
title.romaji: Gomen ne... Watashi... Hoka no Otoko no Hito to...

187418.description:
A profound character. What are Mitsuki's true feelings...!?

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten BEAST 2025-03

187419.description:
Springtime decorated body in a classroom...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic X-Eros #42.

187420.description:
Her true form laid bare by lust. ♥♥

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2024-10.

187421.description:
The second part of Nadeshiko Hiyori.

After joining the tea ceremony club, Rino and Yuuna start taking part in its lesbian activities. Meanwhile, their friend Nako is still not sure which club to enroll in.

187422.description: Extra chapter released in the ARIA The AVVENIRE Theater Pamphlet.
synonyms: ARIA Special Navigation アクアリア

187423.description: Extra chapter released in the ARIA The CREPUSCOLO Theater Pamphlet.

187424.description: Extra chapter released in the ARIA The BENEDIZIONE Theater Pamphlet.

187425.description:
Haruma and Nagisa have overcome their strained relationship due to their "sex friends contract" and have confirmed their feelings for each other. Now that Haruma is his boyfriend, he grows sweeter with each passing day, and Nagisa is constantly at his mercy with his straightforward expressions of affection...! They are so happy that it's almost scary, and they are enjoying a fulfilling life together as lovers, both physically and mentally.

However, at work they are just senior and junior, and their relationship is still a secret. Even when female customers who are after Haruma ask if he has a girlfriend, he can't bring himself to say that it's "me"... Then, a certain person who is looking for Nagisa appears--!?

What lies beyond the unrequited love that was thought to be impossible to fulfill. [A younger bartender who is at the mercy of Nagisa x A strong-willed and devoted beautiful bar owner] The long-awaited lovers edition restarts!

(Source: ShuCream, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: イミテーション・プレイ2 -dawn-

187426.description:
As Yuria takes her dying breath, she realizes she had just lived through the events of a novel she read in her past life. She laments that she didn't remember early enough to change her fate, so when she wakes up having returned one year in the past, Yuria vows she won't meet the same end again. This time, she will expose the female lead of the novel, her half-sister Lilica, for the true two-faced villainess she is! Will Yuria be able to outsmart Lilica? Or will she lose everything once again?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Villainous Sister Hides Her Wealth

187427.description:
Fresh out of a breakup, game developer Woo-Jin has little going for him. So when he hears that the middle boss of their game is based on him, he can't resist adding a few traits to make his virtual alter ego a tad more noble. Little did he know, he would soon end up trapped in said villain's skin! With a 1 in 1,000 chance of survival, Woo-Jin now has to navigate the countless variables leading him to his impending doom. Will the tweaks he made to the character tip the scales in his favor?

(Source: Tapas)

187428.description:
Worried about your marriage because you're a terrible cook? Don't worry and leave it to us! At The Cooking School, you will leave both very full and satisfied.

(Source: Toomics)

187430.description:
A gamer trapped in his favorite game must fix his mistakes to save a heroine stuck in a lowly role.

(Source: Toomics)

187433.description:
Erika Asakura is 53 years old and works as an editor for a women's magazine. She lives a very peaceful life with her husband who is retired and stays at home, her daughter who has been working for two years, and her cat Della. She is in charge of a feature article on menopause, and is preparing herself for the possibility that it may come soon. One day, after feeling unwell, she goes to the hospital and is told that her female hormones are close to zero. Although she had prepared herself for it, it is a much bigger shock than she expected! At the request of the editor-in-chief, she staggers off to a "meeting" with her idol, Kyoko Ibuki, at what she thinks will be a "lecture," but turns out to be a dance party...!?

(Source: Cocohana, translated)

title.native: ダンシング・ゼネレーションsenior

187434.description:
Once tormented, a man returns rich and powerful to destroy his teacher—using her own daughter.

(Source: Toomics)

187435.description:
During the summer of their third year of college, Honda Ayano and Nishi Takuma met. They couldn't get along, but they fell in love when Nishi took Ayano's photo for a beauty pageant. When Ayano was feeling down after failing her job search and being heartbroken, Nishi clumsily encouraged her, and Ayano began to secretly like Nishi...

(Source: Cocohana, translated)

187436.description:
K City, Hokkaido. Ishizato Mugiho is working hard every day as a new instructor at a computer school, but sometimes things don't go as planned. She heads to the station to go to Sapporo to visit her hobby of electronics stores. She calls out to a young man sleeping in the waiting room, and the two of them take the train to Sapporo together. Although they part ways at the station, the next day he happens to come to try out the computer school where Mugiho works.

It turns out he was an idol in Korea, but his contract expired and he has just returned to Japan. Mugiho feels like she can understand a little bit about how he feels left behind. Will Nosei officially enroll in the computer school...?

(Source: Cocohana, translated)

187438.description:
Soichiro helps his great-grandmother, who is a sorcerer. Although his powers as a sorcerer are no match for his great-grandmother's, he has a "special ability" that his great-grandmother does not have...

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

187439.description:
"It's not the child that is tested in elementary school entrance exams. It's the family."

Nitta Akane, who works for a major cosmetics manufacturer, is a working mother of two, but after learning about the rigors of junior high school entrance exams, she becomes interested in elementary school entrance exams. Her husband is a TV reporter, and the couple are known as a power couple in society, but the world of entrance exams is a battle with even more affluent people. Juggling work and family, a husband who won't cooperate, and mounting education costs...

"I want to give my children as many possibilities as possible in the future" -- that's how it should have started, but... The mom friends she met at the entrance exam cram school are also facing their own hells --?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.romaji: Kimi no Senaka ni Mita Yume wa

187440.description:
Unable to bear the violence from his father, who does not understand that he is gay, Umi runs away from home. In the diverse world of Tokyo, Umi finally finds a place where he can breathe. However, his father, who followed him, is harmed by someone, and he is left to wander between life and death...

What is the certainty that Umi finds in the memories where the past and present intersect? This ambitious work depicts the love and hate between minority families with delicate brushstrokes!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 授乳中のヤンママにパコパコ種付け！！〜そんなに出されたら…ミルクが溢れちゃうっ！
title.romaji: Junyuuchuu no Yanmama ni Pakopako Tanetsuke!! Sonna ni Dasaretara Milk ga Afurechau!

187442.description:
Aya, a new designer at a game development company, is picked on by her boss and transferred to the so-called "kick-out room." This is the thrilling story of a godly artist who creates a new game plan with other creators who have also been kicked out!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: E, Kamieshi wo Oidasun desu ka?

title.native: え、神絵師を追い出すんですか？
title.romaji: E, Kami Eshi wo Oidasun desu ka?

187443.description:
A provocative story about secret lovers in the office!

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

title.native: 男女交際推進制度〜SEXの練習はじめました〜
title.romaji: Danjou Kousai Suishin Seido: SEX no Renshuu Hajimemashita

187445.description:
After being cruelly betrayed by her boyfriend, Mayu, an office lady, meets the beautiful "legal revenger" Ellis and is invited to the legal detective agency she runs. There, Mayu sees the true identity of Ellis, whom she thought was a beautiful woman, and a young girl who calls herself her secretary. Suspicious of Ellis, Mayu tries to leave the place, but Ellis proposes to Mayu the "secret menu" of the legal detective agency.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 異世界サウナでととのいスローライフ ～無知な女冒険者とラブラブ混浴しちゃう～
title.romaji: Isekai Sauna de Totonoi Slow Life: Muchi na Onna Boukensha to Love Love Konyoku Shichau

187448.description:
Seconds before you self exit you hear that your divorced father has passed away, leaving you an unimaginable amount of money. But once you get to his funeral who he left behind, you realize that money isn't the only thing you can take...

(Source: Toomics)

187450.description:
A series of short tales, with twists and turns, all bundled into one!

(Source: Toomics)

187451.description:
Chae Yeon runs a quiet little pension on a remote island—but with her painfully shy personality, dealing with guests is more stress than success. Just as she’s contemplating closing up shop, an unexpected guest checks in: Baek Sanho, her high school classmate…and the guy she once rejected. Now all grown up and annoyingly charming, Sanho seems determined to turn up the heat—on the island and in Yeon’s heart. With old sparks beginning to flicker back to life, this getaway is about to get way too hot to handle.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

187452.description:
At 4, Groo is undoubtedly the youngest S-ranked awakened in the country. But as her kindergarten class's (self-proclaimed) ace, she can take a challenge! So when her first quest window tells her to find a grown-up who'll take her in, she marches down to the top guild in Korea and demands to be recruited. Sensing that this overpowered orphan shouldn't fall into the wrong hands, the guildmaster has no choice but to adopt her. But he has no idea this tiny girl is about to turn his life upside down!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Chick Hunter Is Being Filial!
The Chick Class Hunter Is Being Filial!

187453.description:
Eve, trapped in the cursed Tower of Babel, endlessly dies and revives as she struggles to escape and uncover the truth.

(Source: Toomics)

187454.description:
After losing his mother to the mafia, Ro-Wan goes undercover to destroy the organization from the inside. But things take an unexpected turn when he meets its enigmatic leader, Raphael Valentino…a man he should loathe, but can’t seem to ignore. Determined to bring the seedy underbelly of New York down - whether as Rafael’s hunting dog or as someone powerful enough to crush it from above - Ro-Wan spends years as a member of his gang. But the more time they spend together, the harder it becomes to draw the line between duty and desire. In a world built upon lies and vengeance, can this tangled relationship end in love…or will it all fall apart?

(Source: Lezhin US)

187455.description:
A girl just can't catch a break!

Having wished to live an unconventional life, Emily gets accepted into her dream school, where nobles and commoners are equals. But when she meets her fellow students and gets roped into a crazy love triangle with a prince on her first day, she begins to realize her wish may have already come true.

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: Dejen en paz a Lady Emily
気弱なエミリー令嬢は放っておかれたい

187456.description:
Teen angst in full swing.

U-Jeong's hopes for a normal sophomore year are dashed after a run-in with Se-Ra, a foul-mouthed troublemaker, who has a few choice words for him. What starts out as a simple accident snowballs into a big misunderstanding, and now U-Jeong finds himself tangled up with a bunch of depressed juniors!

(Source: Manta, edited)

187457.description:
Executed for failing to save the emperor, Serena Vincent wakes up again and again on the day she’s assigned as his physician. Azaid Khan Krothen, the emperor's bastard son from a lowly maid, was cast aside at birth. But he now sits on a throne others want to control. As Serena races to cure his mysterious illness, each failure ends in her death. Trapped in a deadly loop, she must find the cure to the emperor's illness... before her next death is her last.

(Source: Tapas)

187458.description:
Reborn into a novel as the unawakened Demon King, Tatiana is imprisoned and exploited by demons who use her power for themselves. When her captors are killed by three heroes—Duke Siegfried Orleans, Archmage Kyrios, and High Priest Cesar—she nurses her saviors back to health, and they adopt her! Now, Tatiana is determined to awaken so she can be independent... But with three protective fathers watching her every move, can this 4-year-old keep her secret long enough to become the Demon King?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Little Demon King Is Too Bothered by Her Brave Dads

title.english: The Baby Demon King Has Too Many Dads
title.native: 아기 마왕님은 용사 아빠들이 너무 귀찮아
title.romaji: Agi Mawangnimeun Yongsa Appadeuri Neomu Gwichana

187459.description:
Struggling streamer Do-Yeon Choi downloads a mysterious dating sim game, Heart-Racing Ghost Dating Sim, only to find himself trapped in a deadly loop-- where the love interests are real-life ghosts with unresolved deaths. From haunted highways to murder cases, Do-Yeon must navigate a world where romance, horror, and mystery collide. Every wrong move could cost him his life...again.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ตึกตัก ๆ เกมรักผีสาว
撲通撲通 女鬼戀愛手遊

187460.description:
After trouble child Kiana Ellie Freley leaves home to pursue her passion, she is satisfied living the academic life as a professor of magical engineering. That is, until her family is wrongly accused of treason and sentenced to death! In a last-ditch effort to reverse their fate, Kiana's cousin Melissa turns back time by one year, but only Kiana retains her memories. With just her summoned creature Chirpy by her side, can Kiana amend relations with her family and prevent their unjust end?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: A Strange but Effective Villainess Life

187461.description:
For two blissful years, So-Ryung's world revolved around her husband—until he vanished without a trace. In her search for answers, she learns the heartbreaking truth that he was never hers to begin with. But she’s not about to let him slip away, even if he is a black ops agent with a hundred faces…

(Source: Manta)

187462.description:
Han Min-Seo grew up in a wealthy and harmonious family. One day, she witnesses her parents' car leaving a motel across from a restaurant she stopped by with her friends. However, Min-Seo does not know which of her parents drove the car. Is it a simple misunderstanding, or is it really an affair? In a truth she does not want to believe, will Min-Seo be able to protect herself and face the truth until the end?

(Source: Naver, translated)

187463.description:
After going back in time using magic to save her mom from the evil emperor, Bebe finally wakes up at the manor of Xenox Ablant, an archduke with strong powers and an even stronger repulsion of the emperor. Some call him crazy, but Bebe believes he would be the perfect stepdad to protect herself and her mom. However, not everyone at the manor is friendly to them, and the threats to their lives only continue. Will Bebe be able to adjust to her new life and protect her loved ones once and for all?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Ended Up Saving My Crazy Stepfather!
หนูนี่แหละที่ช่วยพ่อเลี้ยงสุดคลั่งเอาไว้!
狂人パパができちゃいました

title.english: I Found Myself a Crazy Stepdad!

187465.description:
The girlfriends' unstoppable desires! Stories of different couples!

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 3 prologues.

187466.description:
The Trauma Center series returns! Uncover the gripping prequel to Trauma Center: Golden Hour and follow the emotional journey of Dr. Ganghyeok Baek. Every scar, every choice, every life saved... his story starts here. Witness the making of a medical legend as he takes his first steps into the chaos and courage of trauma care.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Trauma Center ศัลยแพทย์ห้องฉุกเฉิน
外傷重症中心：外科醫師白江赫

187467.description:
After botching a job interview, a man climbs a mountain to end it all, only to wake up in a world of half-human, half-animal creatures. Caught between disbelief and temptation, he must navigate this strange new reality.

(Source: Toomics)

187468.description:
Nayoung, a newlywed bride, looks forward to welcoming her husband back home after working overnight as a police detective. But she comes home only to learn he had been murdered. Unable to trust the police, she takes matters into her own hands to uncover the truth. Too bad for them, though. Nayoung turns out to be a former North Korean spy and notorious elite assassin known to intelligence agencies by the code name "Tarantula." How will the Tarantula avenge her husband's death?

(Source: WEBTOON)

187469.description:
On the day the empire fell to rebellion and invasion from another world, Valen met his end alongside his sister, the Emperor. But when he opened his eyes again, he found himself 40 years in the past. This time, he vowed to do whatever it took to prevent the world’s destruction and protect the Emperor. And his solution? To live an even wilder life than before. “If I was a scoundrel in my past life, then this time… I’ll be the ultimate menace!”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: How to Live as a Tyrant's Spoiled Brat

187470.description:
The "Middle Club" is a male prostitution store that has a lineup of middle-aged men to provide customers with the highest level of healing. Ueno, a timid office worker with a crush on his boss, ends up accidentally choosing an older man who resembles his boss out of curiosity. Ryuuichi, a handsome college student, becomes captivated by the older man he randomly chose. Meanwhile, Hisakawa, a salesman, is chosen by his incompatible colleague, Isogai. Initially, their interactions are strictly business-like, but what happens next...?

(Source: Junet, translated)

187471.description:
Mizuno, a thirty-something office worker who struggles with real-life romance and is a big fan of shoujo manga, ends up spending a night with his subordinate and crush, Meguro, under the influence of alcohol. While tormented by regret, Meguro casually suggests that they start dating...!?

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

title.romaji: Mizuno Shinobu no Risou no Renai

187472.description:
Kaizawa Keitarou (nickname: Keita), who moved to Tokyo from Hokkaido to attend high school, ends up living in a student apartment run by a family friend. There, he meets Miyara Kanami (nickname: Kana), a boy his age who was born in Okinawa. Upon seeing Kana's good looks, Keita impulsively shouts, "Handsome!"—only to have Kana react with disdain. One day, Keita and Kana find themselves alone together and decide to go out…?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

187473.description:
Satomi, a university student, has an extreme tendency to break into a heavy sweat whenever he feels stress or anxiety. One day, he finds himself overwhelmed in a packed train—only to be unexpectedly rescued by his classmate, Ando!?

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

187474.description:
Salesman Ayakawa and designer Yamagishi are notorious for their constant bickering at work! One day, Ayakawa hears from a junior colleague that Yamagishi is in an office romance—and it instantly puts him in a foul mood. After all, he is the one dating Yamagishi! Behind closed doors, the two are actually a sweet and affectionate couple. What happens when their secret office romance comes into play?

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: His Secret Office Romance Partner is Me.

title.native: 社内恋愛の相手は俺ですけど？
title.romaji: Shanai Renai no Aite wa Ore desu kedo?

187478.description:
1. Kanata e (彼方へ)
2. Adam no Abarabone (アダムの肋骨)

title.romaji: Morohoshi Daijirou Tokusenshuu: Dai 1-shuu - Otokotachi no Fuukei

1. Kanata yori (彼方より)

3. Yumemiru Kikai (夢みる機械)

7. Jigoku no Senshi (地獄の戦士)
8. Cooling Off (クーリング・オフ)

title.romaji: Morohoshi Daijirou Tokusenshuu: Dai 2-shuu - Kodomo no Joukei

title.native: 諸星大二郎特選集 第3集 遠い世界
title.romaji: Morohoshi Daijirou Tokusenshuu: Dai 3-shuu - Tooi Sekai

title.native: 諸星大二郎特選集 第4集 蒼の群像
title.romaji: Morohoshi Daijirou Tokusenshuu: Dai 4-shuu - Ao no Gunzou

187483.description: A collection of stories chosen by Morohoshi himself, including a special 2-page manga by Hoshino Yukinobu.

title.native: 諸星大二郎自選短篇集 幻妖館にようこそ
title.romaji: Morohoshi Daijirou Jisen Tanpenshuu: Genyoukan ni Youkoso

187484.description:
Young Lady Who Sees Through Lies × Lie-Hating Duke: A Trembling Romance (?) Comedy!!
Countess’s daughter, Ophelia, has a special ability to detect lies. Because of this ability, she lived in seclusion, unable to interact with others. One day, to catch a glimpse of her admired Duke, Claudio, Ophelia participates in a soirée she dislikes. There, she reacts to the conversation filled with noble flattery, trembling and collapsing at the venue... In her haste to leave, she catches the suspicious eye of Claudio, who begins to watch her closely—?
synonyms: The Grumpy Duke Desires the Manual of the Lady Who Sees Through Lies
The Brooding Duke’s Guide to the Lie-Detecting Lady

title.native: 不機嫌な公爵様はウソ発見器付き令嬢の取説をご所望です
title.romaji: Fukigen na Koushaku-sama wa Uso Hakkenki Tsuki Reijou no Torisetsu wo Goshomou desu

187485.hashtag: #冷遇婿ライフを満喫しようとしたら溺愛ルートに入りました
synonyms: When I tried to enjoy the life of a neglected husband, I ended up taking the route of affection!?

title.native: 冷遇婿ライフを満喫しようとしたら、溺愛ルートに入りました!?
title.romaji: Reiguu Muko Life wo Mankitsu Shiyou to Shitara, Dekiai Route ni Hairimashita!?

187487.description:
"A man who lost his life in an accident is reincarnated into an otome game world with a mission given by gods who want entertainment. And the background story in the game is that she is incarnated as the villain princess character Marianne Biesround, who turns out to be a good person but she is instead exiled after that the game will be speedrun and streamed!? He was told the sooner he was exiled the more benefits he would get in the next life, along with the start of the game he invited all the characters to fight so he could be exiled quickly, but instead, he was invincible and became a popular person... !?

Respected by the original protagonist, a handsome aristocrat makes the main character his goal and he is trained by a cheat class, in the end, this otome game deviates from the original story too!! Fighting for her next life, she will destroy all those who stand in her way (and blow them away) with the strongest magic, ""meteor”!

The manga adaptation of the violent webnovel otome game has begun!!!"

title.native: TS悪役令嬢神様転生善人追放配信RTA～嫌われ追放エンドを目指してるのに最強無双ロードから降りられない～
title.romaji: TS Akuyaku Reijou Kamisama Tensei Zennin Tsuihou Haishin RTA - Kiraware Tsuihou End wo Mezashiteru no ni Saikyou Musou Road kara Orirarenai

187488.description:
"In a twist of fate, a diligent ronin student finds himself transported to an unfamiliar realm. This unexpected journey began when he valiantly attempted to stop a robbery alongside a female store clerk.

Longing for a unique ability that he could hone through hard work, he sought the blessings of a deity. Consequently, he was endowed with two rare talents: ""Innate Talent"", allowing him to consistently surpass others, and ""Clairvoyance"", which grants him the insight to assess both individuals and objects.

Yet, there's a catch; he requires thrice the standard experience to ascend in levels.

Reborn as Mars, the second son of a noble viscount lineage, he remains committed to refining his abilities. However, the town's periphery shows alarming indications of an imminent monster incursion.

Thus, Mars' extraordinary journey of reincarnation in this fantastical world commences."
synonyms: Tensei Shitara Sainou ga Atta Ken: Isekai Itte mo Doryoku suru
That Time I Got Reincarnated With Talent ~I'll Work Hard Even if I Go to Another World~

title.native: 転生したら才能があった件～異世界行っても努力する～
title.romaji: Tensei Shitara Sainou ga Atta Ken - Isekai Itte mo Douryoku suru

187489.description:
Kwon Jinha is a fit and healthy kindergarten teacher until she gets too obsessed with a silly web novel. Gradually, she starts feeling the aches and pains of the main character, the maid Elby Tindale, until she suddenly enters the novel as Elby! Facing a toxic secret relationship with the male lead Flynn Raiders, Jinha's version of the novel is a virtual reality game in which her mission is to figure out how to kill Flynn... or be forever stuck with this obsessive creep!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I'm Going to Kill the Male Lead
I Will Kill the Male Protagonist
男主人公を殺す筋書きを描いてみます

title.english: I Will Kill the Male Lead

187490.description:
As the legitimate heir to the imperial throne, Yullikian kuhn Rondenez is desperate to find a way to keep his usurping uncle from killing him next. Frequenting the slums to make it seem like he's become a gambler, he crosses paths with Maddie, a notorious pickpocket who is willing to do anything for the right price, even kill. That's when he comes up with a crazy plan. Yullikian proposes to Maddie to get his uncle off his back, but will this fake marriage lead to mad love or just madness?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Don't Worry, We Both Agreed to This Fraudulent Marriage
俺と彼女の完璧なろくでなし生活

title.english: My Mad Fake Marriage to Maddie

187491.description:
Empress Niobe Roden, the precious Blue Rose of the Rustan Empire, is in love with another man--the one to save her from her tyrant husband. She patiently waits for her lover Eloi, but all that returns is the news that the Emperor has beheaded him. Hopeless in her own imprisonment, Niobe ends her life only to be returned to the past–exactly two years before her marriage with Valon. With the second chance at life, Niobe is determined to conceal and protect her true love.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.
synonyms: Pour te sauver de ta tragique destinée

title.english: A Second Chance at Saving You
title.native: 私だけを愛する無慈悲な将軍
title.romaji: Watashi dake wo Aisuru Mujihi na Shougun

187492.description:
A secret island where only the most vicious criminals are sent to... the rules of society don't apply to Prison Island!

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

187493.description:
Mi-reu is an imugi who failed to ascend to heaven because she was betrayed by a human. After centuries of honing her sword of vengeance, she finally reincarnates and meets Keum Juyong, who carries the soul responsible for her demise. But for some reason, she keeps getting entangled in Juyong’s game instead! Will Mi-reu successfully get her sultry revenge?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of RIDI's Yongyongjukgetji Danpyeonseon (용용죽겠지 단편선) Collection..
synonyms: แค้นรักอสรพิษ

187494.description:
Raised with a strict upbringing as the son of a pastor, Kim Petros has always lived his life by the book - the Holy Book that is! Resolving to set off on his own path in search of independence, he makes the decision to pursue priesthood. But as the long years he spends in priestly training drag on, and he finds himself in need of a hobby to help pass the time, he decides to step outside his comfort zone and buy a secondhand gaming console. Petros is soon to find, however, that he’s getting much more than he bargained for when the seller, a spirited young woman and his polar opposite, mistakenly brings an adult toy. Could this mysterious woman have just the cure for his boredom, or will she prove to be his ruin instead?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of RIDI's Yongyongjukgetji Danpyeonseon (용용죽겠지 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: We Reached an Agreement Through Prayer?!

187495.description:
When it comes to passing the civil service exam, there’s only one name that matters: Han Miryu! For a thousand years, Miryu has been a legendary instructor, helping countless Guardians secure civil servant positions. Yet, she harbors a secret weakness she can’t share with anyone—Won Daehan, the only student who, despite her efforts, still failed the exam. To protect her reputation, Miryu devises a desperate plan: drain the excess yang energy from Daehan’s body. With only three days left until the big exam, the ultimate question remains—will Daehan finally pass the Guardian recruitment exam?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of RIDI's Yongyongjukgetji Danpyeonseon (용용죽겠지 단편선) Collection.

187496.description:
One night, Yahiro (17) accidentally watches a video of his 21-year-old brother appearing in gay porn and spends a sleepless night in shock. When morning comes, his brother is there as usual, making breakfast and preparing his lunch. Unable to meet his brother’s eyes out of embarrassment and confusion, Yahiro begins a painful struggle with his feelings.

Note: Originally self-published, was then licensed by Hakusensha for serialization.

187497.description:
Compilation of 4 one-shots by Satomo Saegu, published in Margaret magazines :
- Mitsumeteitai
- Ki mama na Page Boy
- Tokudai Size no Koi Yohou
- Omen wo Tsuketa Paradise Boy

187498.description:
Masato Kawa, who has been a recluse for 15 years after being bullied in junior high school, lives in a depopulated small town. He decides to take up a challenge in order to take revenge on the person who changed his life.

(Source: Natalie.mu, translated and adapted)

187499.description: Short Serialization to celebrate the Anime Adaptation

187500.description:
A depressed woman taking time off work to recuperate from the struggle of day to day life decides to create a large sculpture of a beautiful man as part of her healing process...

But one day during the process, she's attacked by hoodlums!
Things aren't looking so good... until a tall man appears and saves her.

His name is Yuki, and he is the statue the sculptor created, brought to magical life. Now it's his duty to protect her. Despite his build, however, his mind is rather immature. As a bonus, he's just packed with love! Overflowing love... that just doesn't know when to stop!

(Source: DLSite, translated)

Will Itaru be able to grow and overcome both his impotence and his feelings of inadequacy and find his way to happiness?

In their hotel room, he explains that his late father is the head of the Kikuchi Department Store, and that he wants to run away from home and become a TV producer instead of carrying on the lucrative family business. The girl, Morikawa Seira, takes this wonderful opportunity to steal a photo of his father and fake her way into the family as his illegitimate sister!

After he unexpectedly loses the second of those things, he finds himself living with the unsympathetic family of his father's brother. Years later, it is a miserable and damaged Yuta who enters a new school that is terrorized by the son of a yakuza, Taniguchi. ……are these the bloody villains I’ve seen? My father and brother, who people said to be cruel, were too sweet to me. But the villain has a death ending! It was the first time I received love and warmth, and I decided to change the cruel ending of my friendly family since I possessed it 10 years earlier than the original. Yeah, I will definitely change my family’s future……

“Erita, I love you.”

What’s wrong with the Male Lead?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: I Became the Villain's Lost Daughter

187609.description:
University student Shunpei is so dedicated to helping others and volunteering that he's earned the nickname "The All-Out College Student." His passion is so intense that people can’t help but wonder—why does he go that far? One day, while taking a break between lectures, Shunpei is suddenly kissed by a mysterious, handsome young man!? The stranger, Yukiya, claims that Shunpei once saved him in the past—and without hesitation, he moves right into Shunpei’s apartment…!?

(Source: Taiyoh Tosho, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

187612.description:
When it's your livelihood on the line, you've got to be willing to do anything to get your hands on the treasure!
It is the twilight of the shogunate in Japan, the Bakumatsu, a time of tumult in which ruffians from all walks of life vie for supremacy. Hanagusuku Muta, a Ryukyuan boy from a disgraced clan of nobles, now lives in poverty, stealing just to survive. But one day, he hears rumors of a massive cache of treasure left by a legendary pirate on a small island in the kingdom, one valuable enough to throw all of Japan into disarray. After getting framed for a crime he didn't commit by a group of Satsuma samurai, Muta gets dragged into the vigorous, bloody struggle for the treasure...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

187614.description: A gigantic brown bear beyond human comprehension actually exists! A TV crew enters the forest without much thought, but one by one they fall prey to the monster. Even in extreme situations where we need to help and support each other, it is foolish human nature to doubt and not trust each other. And the overwhelming animal nature of the brown bear swallows it all up! Will the human, the bear, or someone else survive?

187617.description: A black mist covers the sky, a ruined city, monstrous creatures, and non-human beings. The ones who delve into all these mysteries are the strange siblings living in such a world—Hakumei and Hinata. And so, their pure yet twisted sibling love is explored.

187618.description:
Okada-kun, a capable businessman, has been secretly in love with his easygoing high school classmate, Uozumi-kun, for years. After giving up on confessing his feelings at a class reunion two years ago, they drifted apart—until a certain incident brought them back in touch. Every time they meet, Okada resolves to finally confess… but once again, he just can’t say it. A heartwarming comedy filled with nervous excitement and sweet, lingering glances!

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 岡田くんは今日も言えない

187619.description:
Temptation that turns overripe lust into passionate deeds…

(Source: Fakku!) Note: Published in Comic X-Eros #52

187621.description:
Everyday life is too fleeting to be taken for granted. The long-awaited latest work by Ichinohe Sensei, the genius of the next generation! 45 pages of rebellious tales of friendship!

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

187622.description: Note: Published in COMIC HOTMiLK Koime Vol. 17

title.native: 若槻、マスクをとってよ!

187624.description:
Akira is boyish in both looks and personality—and Daichi, her childhood friend turned boyfriend by their first year of high school, thinks she's too cute. Girly outfits aren’t her thing... so why does he suddenly find her in a cat-eared maid costume at the school festival?! Awkward but sweet moments abound in this wholesome friends-to-lovers romcom.

(Source: Manga UP!)

Note: Takou no Boyish Kanojo is a web manga released on the author's Twitter account since September 4, 2024, and published in print by Square Enix since March 22, 2025.
synonyms: My Boyish Girlfriend Is Too Cute

title.native: ボーイッシュ彼女が可愛すぎる

187625.description:
The Emperor of Evil, Ichidaiji Hiiro, and the Warrior of Justice, Hiroin Manami, fight each other every day, at any time, at any place, even at school! Aside from the usual conflict, both live their high-school life at Super Electric High School (超電寺学園), full of fun and slightly erotic moments.

(Source: Amazon, translated and edited)

synonyms: My Daughter And I Are Not Blood-Related

187630.description:
The long-awaited JUMP+ debut of the genius Ichinohe Sensei! Alien vs. cursed creature! A unique 51-page cross epoch horror manga by a promising newcomer to JUMP!

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

187632.description:
For two decades, Actress Kang Seo has been haunted by terrible nightmares. Then, out of the blue, San Han, the man who always rescued her in those dreams, appears before her in real life as her personal bodyguard. Will Kang be able to uncover the true identity of this mysterious figure?

(Source: WEBTOONS)
