旦那様がちっちゃいモフモフになりました ～私を悪女だと誤解していたのに、すべて義母の嘘だと気づいたようです～
title.romaji: Danna-sama ga Chicchai Mofumofu ni Narimashita: Watashi wo Akujo dato Gokai shiteita noni, Subete Gibo no Uso dato Kizuita You desu

187637.description:
Megu, an elementary school student who is not very good at studying or sports, is proud of her best friend Ten-chan. Ten-chan is a genius who can do anything and is everyone's superhero. So she had no idea. Deep in Ten-chan's heart, a sad secret and reality was hidden.

A sad and pure story reflected in the eyes of young boys!

(Source: Office YOU, translated)

187638.description:
Yuki, a video game commentator, is a heavy online shopper. The deliveryman who comes to Yuki's house is Hozumi, a.k.a. "Angel-chan", who is Yuki's exact type. He tries to get closer to him by trial and error, but it doesn't go well. However, when he gets locked in his house after another deliveryman leaves a delivery, Hozumi rescues him and they suddenly become close!!!! He finds out that he is a listener of his gameplay videos, and they exchange contact information in the heat of the moment!! With the help of his childhood friend, Genkazu, he confesses his feelings to him while they are all camping, and they end up having sex for the first time...♥ A fun and lovey-dovey life begins! ...Or so he thought, but a huge misunderstanding has occurred...?

(Sorce: Takeshobo, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: らしくないよね、恋だよね
title.romaji: Rashikunai yo ne, Koi da yo ne

187639.description:
One day, Toru, a young paranormal content creator, visits an abandoned hospital for research. What will this ghost skeptic encounter there...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

187640.description:
Shinta Eda, a college dropout working at the Chinese restaurant “Chun Feng Ting” where he meets the beautiful waitress Yukine Hayashi. Unfortunately, she has no interest in him, and she scolds him all the time, threatening to get him fired…

Until one day… when a mysterious hermit appears before him, and offers him the power to hypnotize other people in exchange for a contract…

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)
synonyms: Secret Slut Story Of Chun Fong Ting

187641.description:
Juuji has been secretly in love with his friend Kumon, his heart racing at every unintentional gesture and word. His mind is constantly in turmoil, on the verge of bursting with unspoken feelings. One day, their female classmates ask Juuji to find out who Kumon has a crush on. But he knows that the moment he asks, his own one-sided love will likely come to an end. Summoning his courage, Juuji finally asks—and Kumon casually admits, "Yeah, I like someone." Just like that, Juuji’s hopes are crushed. He always knew a romance between two guys was impossible, yet deep down, he had still clung to a sliver of hope. Now, forced to confront his feelings, he tries to act as just a friend. But with the biggest event of the year—the school trip—approaching, Juuji’s emotions are anything but calm…!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

187642.description:
Van is a mermaid who has lost everything—his voice, his family, his very place in the world. Forced to work as a slave in a mansion located in a town by the sea, he dreams of the day when he can return to the water. One day he meets Jens, the sole inhabitant of the cursed island of Fiska, a young man who proves to be kinder than any human Van has ever met. As the two grow closer, Jens is determined to buy Van’s freedom and bring him to his island home. But in order for this to happen, Van and Jens need to become more than just good friends…they need to fall in love.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Fish and Water are in the Woods

title.english: As Fish to Water: Where the Forest Meets the Sea

187643.description:
Kei and Shouma have a winter-summer romance going on and have been dating for six months. The first three months were great! But then Kei, 43, started to treat university student Shouma like his son, and before Shouma knew it, they hadn’t been intimate for three months. One day while grabbing a coat from Kei’s closet, Shouma finds something. That something is about to transform his life and relationships in more ways than one…

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.english: Should I Really Not Have Listened...?
title.native: 聴くんじゃなかった…ホントに
ケーキ・ドッグ・カラメリゼ

187646.description:
Luent, the world of illusion, is a world ruled by beastmen and inhabited by mythical beasts. A wandering mythical beast trimmer, Balm, and his comrades go on a journey to find the mother of a new species of young mythical beast, Poro! A slightly scary fantasy!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

187647.description:
The story centers around Yui, a high school boy who often goes with the flow of those around him, which typically ends up with him going along with things he doesn't agree with. In these situations, he is fed up with his inability to do anything but say no.

On the other hand, there's his eccentric classmate Haru, who is completely unable to read between the lines. Then, a certain incident leads Yui to lash out at Haru, "Read the room! Do you know what it means to ’play along'? That's how you create good relationships with people," to which Haru responds, "How meaningless."

187648.description:
Hina, a high school girl aiming to become a doctor, slips into the Heian period during a school trip! There, she is asked to take the place of Minamoto no Yoshitsune! Her only source of comfort is Taira no Koremori, a member of the Taira clan, who are enemies of the Minamoto clan!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

187649.description:
Misora, an "unwanted child" who escaped from a dome-shaped colony that represents the ideal form of human society, is taken in by an old-fashioned town where only adults live. However, there is something strange about this town and the adults in it!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

187651.description:
Sonezaki Shinji, a freelance writer who specializes in the occult, is a "supernatural cleaner" who solves supernatural cases. He is pursuing the mystery of multiple severed fingers with matching DNA. In order to get to the truth behind the fingers that have been discovered one after another in the town, Sonezaki takes university student Takeda Kagekiyo with him to investigate. There, the two witness a supernatural phenomenon and realize that they are approaching the location where it is located...

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: The Case of Shinji Sonezaki, the Mysterious Cleaner
The Sweeper of the Unnamable Things

title.native: 怪異の掃除人・曽根崎慎司の事件
title.romaji: Kaii no Souji Hito Sonezaki Shinji no Jiken

187652.description:
One day, Akira gets lost in a world where wizards and humans coexist. In this world, the moon that attacks the world is feared as a "great disaster", and Akira, as a sage, saves the world together with the wizards who fight against the moon. Akira participates in a parade in the royal capital with the wizards and is welcomed by the townspeople. However, there is also a wizard who does not appear...

The story of the battle between the wizards and the sage and the moon unfolds.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

187653.description:
Yamato, who has been trying to make a living as a freelancing musician since graduating from high school, has to move in with his reclusive step-sister, Rinne, due to his parent's remarriage. When Yamato finds out that Rinne is a V-tuber, he decides to write a theme song for her. When he looks up her videos for musical inspiration…

"Kon-Mikua ♥ 'Ryugu Mikua' here, ya! I'm still learning how to be a good girl, so please keep on supporting me ♥"

It's a red-hot comedy with a step-sister who has the biggest gap between her real and virtual faces!

(Source: Square-Enix, translated)

title.romaji: V na Imouto no Love Song

title.native: 拝啓、天国の姉さん、勇者になった姪がエロすぎてーー 叔父さん、保護者とかそろそろ無理です＋
title.romaji: Haikei, Tengoku no Nee-san, Yuusha ni Natta Mei ga Ero Sugite ── Ojisan, Hogosha Toka Sorosoro Muri desu Plus

title.native: 拝啓、天国の姉さん、勇者になった姪がエロすぎてーー 叔父さん、保護者とかそろそろ無理です＋
title.romaji: Haikei, Tengoku no Nee-san, Yuusha ni Natta Mei ga Ero Sugite ── Ojisan, Hogosha Toka Sorosoro Muri desu Plus

187656.description:
Late at night, while working part-time at a convenience store, college student Yamamoto reunites with his former high school classmate, Megumi Hayashi. Back in school, she was known as the class’s most beautiful girl, yet also a proud and arrogant “queen.” Though the two didn’t get along in high school, Yamamoto discovers bruises on her wrist and, intending it to be just for one night, shelters her from her abusive boyfriend. Before he realizes it, however, a strange cohabitation begins.

Confused by the situation, the two gradually come to see sides of each other they never knew before. What was supposed to be the worst living arrangement turns out to be surprisingly comfortable…!?

A frustrating yet heart-fluttering romantic comedy about cohabitation between a wounded “queen” and an emotionally detached young man.
synonyms: Living together with the queen from my high school days

title.native: 高校時代に傲慢だった女王様との同棲生活は意外と居心地が悪くない
title.romaji: Koukou Jidai ni Gouman Datta Joou-sama to no Dousei Seikatsu wa Igai to Ikigokochi ga Warukunai

title.native: 乙女ゲームのモブなのに、なぜか推しに愛を囁かれています!
title.romaji: Otome Game no Mob Nanoni, Naze ka Oshi ni Ai wo Sasayakarete Imasu!

187658.description:
Gomi Jirou, a 29 year old virgin, has spent the past 9 years nerding out with his work colleagues about anime during lunch and drawing erotic doujinshi at night so he can masturbate.

However, one day, this comfort zone of his is thrown into disarray by the introduction of a new colleague, Yumezora Kuroko, a bespectacled beauty with long, dark hair and a massive chest.

It only takes a moment to fall in love, just like how it takes a moment to lose your footing.

This is the story of a weak man's sins and sexual fixations.

title.native: ゲーム中盤で死ぬ悪役貴族に転生したので、外れスキル【テイム】を駆使して最強を目指してみた
title.romaji: Game Chuuban de Shinu Akuyaku Kizoku ni Tensei Shita node, Hazure Skill [Tame] wo Kushi Shite Saikyou wo Mezashite Mita

187660.description:
A beautiful homunculus left behind by a great alchemist master―Joshua, a young alchemist, travels with a homunculus named Coco. Even though he has no emotions, Coco is the only partner Joshua can trust. Coco pretends to be human to hide his true identity, but for some reason, he hugs Joshua every night with passionate eyes...!?

(source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

title.native: 錬金術師と青のともしび
政略結婚の相手に「私のこと好きになって」とお祈りした結果
title.romaji: Seiryaku Kekkon no Aite ni ''Watashi no Koto Suki ni Natte'' to Oinori Shita Kekka

187662.description:
Eve Jenna, a poor noblewoman from the countryside, had only her beauty and practical mindset to rely on. In pursuit of financial stability, she became the fourth wife of Count Hound, hoping for security, if not love. Three years into their marriage, her seemingly stable life is shattered when her husband abruptly demands a divorce. That same night, Eve receives an unexpected visit from Azazel, her husband’s eldest son, who had always kept his distance. Without a trace of humor, he makes a shocking proposal: after her divorce, she should marry him. Stunned by the audacity of his offer, Eve dismisses it as mockery, but his next words leave her speechless—he’s always desired her. What began as a contract marriage soon spirals into a series of events Eve could never have foreseen.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: เมื่อข้าคือรักแรกของเขา

title.english: I Became the First Love of My Stepson

187664.description:
GP Stories hidden behind the scenes that could not be told. The truth is better hidden.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes prologue.

187665.description:
To secure her future financial and career success, studious high school student Chie aims to get accepted into the prestigious Tokyo University. Meanwhile her best friend, the air-headed goofball Kanae, just wants to enjoy her life in the moment. One day, Kanae buys a lottery ticket and ends up winning first prize! And how much money is that you may ask? A staggering 700 million yen! When the girls decide to split the winnings, Chie suddenly finds that the burden of being responsible for such a fortune is too much and she ends up flunking her entrance exams! With her planned-out future crumbling around her, Chie decides, “Screw it!”. If her life isn’t going to go the way she’d planned, then she’s going to use her newfound fortune to live the best life she ever could!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title.native: ドリーム☆ジャンボ☆ガール

synonyms: There's No Way Himeka-Chan, The Kemololi Mesugaki, Will Ever Lose To Some Lolicon Old Men!!

title.native: メスガキケモロリひめかちゃんがロリコンおじさんなんかに負けるわけがない!!
title.romaji: Mesugaki Kemo Loli Himeka-chan ga Lolicon Oji-san Nanka ni Makeru Wake ga Nai!!

187667.description:
This is Seifukucho. The crime rate has always been zero, and everyone around is nice. It's unthinkable to even speak ill of others, let alone commit violence. Shiozaki Kokoro naturally thought so too. That was until she met the mysterious transfer student Miyabe Kyo. "I'll show you what kind of town this is really like."

(Source: Our Feel, translated)

title.native: パペット・イン・ザ・シティ
ヤンキーちゃんのマッチング

187670.description:
The fate of an entire nation rests on the shoulders of one girl.

World War III has finally broken out. After fierce fighting, Japan has been carved up and placed under foreign rule. Miharu, a prodigy with unrivaled sniper skills, meets Shou, a former marksman who can no longer bring himself to pull the trigger on a human target. Together, they are drawn into fights that will decide the fate of their homeland.

A sniper buddy action epic set in a war‑torn Japan!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

187671.description:
The story begins with Ato Haruki, an investigator at the Otowa Detective Agency, waking up in his office. His colleague Shinano seems to have gone to the convenience store. While waiting for him to return, Ato tries to get some work done. It seems that his next assignment is a disappearance case involving a new religious group called the "Shikoten Research Institute." As Ato worries about Shinano's late return, strange things start happening in the office...

This is a "biosuppression x action story that culminates in uncovering the truth."

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 細胞神曲-Cell of Empireo.- A certain "0.5"
title.romaji: Saibou Shinkyoku- Cell of Empireo.- A certain "0.5"

187672.description:
Mai Sasaki, who lives in Tokyo, was supposed to end her life due to illness. However, just before she died, her grandmother bestowed her with magical knowledge and powers, and sent her off to another world. Now that she is healthy again, Mai resolves not to waste the life she has been given, and opens a cafe called "Hideout" at the end of the royal capital. Henry, the castle's top civil servant, who frequently visits Mai's "Hideout," seems to have a secret...

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: The Royal Capital's Dead-End Cafe "Hideout" ~The Chief Civil Official Comes to Relax in My Shop After I Accidentally Became a Wizard~

title.native: 王都の行き止まりカフェ『隠れ家』〜うっかり魔法使いになった私の店に筆頭文官様がくつろぎに来ます〜
title.romaji: Outo no Ikidomari Cafe “Kakurega”: Ukkari Mahoutsukai ni Natta Watashi no Mise ni Hittou Bunkan-sama ga Kutsurogi ni Kimasu

187673.description:
A "distorted communal comedy" about men in cute maid outfits and the only daughter of a mafia boss.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 月見里家のメイド男子

187674.description:
A comedy about the Demon King's son, Luka, who goes to the human world to train to become a Demon King himself. However, Luka has an angelic, kind personality, and is also naive and innocent, which leads to many dangerous actions. Claude, the butler who accompanies him as a watchdog, watches over Luka with a slightly overprotective attitude, but is thrown into a frenzy by Luka's unconventional behavior, which exceeds his expectations...

The story depicts the adventures of the future Demon King.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

187675.description:
1-3. Coin Laundry Hatsukoi Hakusho

About a serious honors student and her laidback teacher who lives in poverty. First chapter starts when she's 15 and the second chapter timeskips to when she's 18.

4-5. Kare wa Dare, Dare-so Kare
6. Rakudai Tenshi
synonyms: My First Love at the Coin Laundry

title.native: コインランドリー初恋白書

synonyms: Through the Power of Words, Grant Me My Wishes, Tokie-sensei

title.native: コトダマ叶えて! ときえ先生

187679.description:
I am in a relationship with two women… Will this relationship be a dream come true or a total disaster…?!

(Source: Toomics)

187680.description:
Two brothers live two seperate lives, but they share one face.

(Source: Toomics)

187681.description:
Makoto Noda, a run-of-the-mill Japanese teacher, endures ridicule from his students while struggling to manage a classroom on the verge of collapse.

On a fateful day, a misunderstanding leads to a slap from a PE teacher, causing him to hit his head on the corner of a desk and lose consciousness. When he awakens, he finds himself facing a mysterious window. As he completes them, his real-life stats improve and he also acquires special items...!

With his newfound ability, can Noda save the failing school from ruin?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

187682.description:
Seto-san is the pretty and cool class representative. Her laugh must surely be lovely... I wanna see it!!

This is a short-format comic about Tsumugi-chan, a clumsy girl who has had some contact with Seto-san since the entrance ceremony, and who is determined to try various tactics to make Seto-san laugh, without success. But there's something strange about Seto-san's behavior!!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: Tsumugi-chan Wants to Make Seto-san Laugh

title.native: 瀬戸さんを笑わせたい紬ちゃん

187683.description:
The "everyday" lives of Fuuna Minami, an eccentric girl who loves model railroading, and Mari, a normal girl, become "extraordinary" with nostalgic products from the early days of N gauge.

(Source: Neko Publishing, translated)
synonyms: Tezmo Syndrome: Cases of Lazy Railroading

title.native: テツモ・シンドローム

187684.description:
I was reincarnated as “Luxe,” the villain with the “Evil Eye”, but I didn’t want to meet a miserable end after being reincarnated into my favorite game!

I decided to find happiness, I started training in “Dark Magic” from that day on in order to fight off the forces that attacked me insearch of the Evil Eye. And eventually, I’ll become a mob that watches over… my favorite characters! This is the story of how I, who was reincarnated as the villain of my favorite game, and my efforts to change my fate.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: I Was Reincarnated as the Villain with Evil Eyes, So I Aim to Be a Mob Character

187687.description: By a twist of fate, Natsumi Chako and Junko Oda end up living under the same roof. Caught between the innocence of childhood dreams and the harsh realities of adulthood, the two struggle to reconcile their ideals with the world around them. As they face the growing gap between dreams and reality, they gradually learn to navigate life together, awkwardly but sincerely.

title.native: 無法正義 許されざる警察

synonyms: Tomodachi no Haha wo Netoru: Osaerarenai Shoudou
友達の母を寝取る～抑えられない衝動

187692.description:
The soul of Nobunaga, who was engulfed in flames at Honnoji, did not disappear. When the fire exploded, his soul was ejected from his body and transported to another world.

After crossing over to another world, his soul entered the young body of Roselia Romanesco, the eldest daughter of a local lord, who was on the verge of death.

No sooner had she accepted her reincarnation than news arrived of the death of her father, the head of the family... With barely a moment to catch her breath, the girl heads to the battlefield to take her revenge.

This is the story of how Roselia Romanesco united the world.

(Source: Comic Valkyrie, translated)
synonyms: Nobunaga Reincarnated as a Young Girl Unifies the Other World

187694.description:
A manga anthology, based on Game Cube game by the same name.

Note: Released in Enix Supercomic Gekijoh Volume 69.

Enix Supercomic Gekijoh: Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles

187697.description:
Yuu Oikawa, a shut-in at home who is 22 years old, is doomed to die a virgin because the entire world has turned into a place overflowing with zombies… until one survivor shows up at his house. That woman, who calls herself Sunny, injects Yuu with a vaccine that has the potential to save the zombified world…but as a result, Yuu gains the power to revert zombies back into humans through sex—?

(Source: Kurage Bunch, translated)
synonyms: Only My Vaccine Can Save the World From the Zombie Apocalypse

title.romaji: Ore no Vaccine dake ga Zombie-ka shita Sekai wo Sukueru

title.native: 瀧夜叉姫 陰陽師絵草子

187701.description:
No matter how great her date may be, Rajung's love could never coexist with their body hair. The passion and excitement of a new relationship died instantly when she saw "hair": a hairy chest, hairy legs, the five o'clock shadow, etc. It's like losing your appetite when you find hair in your food; it doesn't matter how good the dish is or if it's to your taste. At this rate, there's a good chance Rajung will die without ever seeing a man's penis, let alone having sex. Then her best guy friend, without batting an eye, said to her:

"Guess I should pluck all my pubic hair and show you mine."

(Source: Lezhin US)

187702.description: Note: Chapter count includes a side story.

187703.description:
When Rona manifests what seems to be a terribly useless skill, she’s considered an embarrassment to her family and gets kicked out of the house. With no money or food, she nears her darkest hour… when she suddenly figures out how to use her skill called “Internet.” It allows her to produce unlimited valuable items and even acquire rare equipment without participating in any events. With this skill of godlike knowledge, she can do anything she wants!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: 世界最強の魔女、始めました　～私だけ『攻略サイト』を見れる世界で自由に生きます～
title.romaji: Sekai Saikyou no Majo, Hajimemashita: Watashi dake "Kouryaku Site" wo Mireru Sekai de Jiyuu ni Ikimasu

187705.description:
Friends, rivals, and respect. Four girls meet by chance while trying to grab the last cake at the cafe Full House. They go to different schools and are all different ages, but after they meet, they soon become good friends before they knew it… On the good days when they laugh, and on the bad days when they cry, these four are always the cutest, right? A happy, full-color comic that was a hot topic on social media, now published with 78 additional pages of color illustrations!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

187706.description:
1. Sabakusen (砂漠船)
2. Uchuu Misaki (宇宙岬)

187707.description:
Hua Yingying transmigrated into the body of a poor orphan girl. When her life was hanging by a thread, an immortal master descended from the heaven to save her from danger. So Hua Yingying teased and flattered her master day and night, until she finally melted the master's icy heart. As soon as her master could overcome her final tribulation, they can be together for mutual cultivation and other naughty things… But who could have imagined that the master would fail the tribulation and crumble into dust! Now in order to resurrect her master, Hua Yingying must search the seven mirror realms to find the seven shards of her master and make love with each of them! Hua Yingying clenches her fists in frustration, "I'm only forming a harem so I can save my master!"

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: I Was Forced to Open a Harem to Resurrect the Master I Had a Crush on

title.romaji: Wei Le Fuhuo Anlian De Shizun Wo Bei Po Kai Le Hougong

187708.description:
In Damyeon, where there are no tourist attractions, seeing a foreigner is very rare… especially one covered in blood. It’s the first time in all Yuhui’s 20 years that she’s seen someone who looked like a mobster.

“I’ve been wondering this since earlier, Baby…”
“Yes?”
“Did you get that wet thing out on purpose to show me?”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: モーテルのヤクザおじさん〜片田舎に来た怪しいお客様〜

title.native: ミタマセキュ霊ティ 特別番外編／ミタマVS白鳥
title.romaji: Mitama Security: Tokubetsu-hen - Mitama VS Hakuchou

187710.description:
When famous porn actress Yuri Miyama announced her shocking retirement, Shikishima, a convenience store manager and superfan, fell into despair. One day, a woman named Tamagawa, who looks just like Yuri, comes to interview for a part-time job at his store! Shikishima is desperate to find out if she is who he thinks she is but knows he can't ask her directly. In order to uncover Tamagawa's potential secret identity, he and his other porn-loving co-worker come up with one absurd plan after another... Just who is Tamagawa, really?

(Source: Square Enix)

title.native: 玉川さん 出てました?

187711.description:
A new sinner. A new week. Encounters and farewells continue.

Mimi, the cat-eared assassin, is an unusual hitwoman who grants her targets their desired final week before their inevitable end.

"Let me be part of your family, Mimi-senpai!"

Having relocated to a new country, Mimi is soon joined by an assassin from the intelligence division—Codename 46, also known as Shiro. Deeply admiring Mimi, Shiro is assigned as her apprentice, and together, they witness the final moments of their targets.

A dying painter with only a week left to live, a young researcher who killed his own parents, a former mercenary who betrayed his employer—what will Mimi take away from these fleeting encounters with new sinners?

A continuation of the story that follows the cat-eared assassin and the criminals who have only one week left to live.

(Source: GA Bunko, translated)
synonyms: In A Week, I Will Kill You. ―Bon Voyage―

title.native: 一週間後、あなたを殺します ―Bon Voyage―
title.romaji: Isshuukan Go, Anata wo Koroshimasu: Bon Voyage

187712.description:
It seems to have been suddenly carved into the body of a living creature.The engraved humans became able to handle special powers,the world was plunged into confusion due to the magnitude of their power.

Half a century after the appearance of the runes...

Yusuke, who has been exterminating evil demons as a heroic “Oni-killer” of Japan, achieves the conditions of his own rune, “The Book of Chudo,” and obtains the skill to return to the past. All in order to save his precious friends who were lost in the defeat of the Lamia Queen about 30 years ago.

The powerful rune battle is about to begin!

187713.description:
Sano Tsukasa, a first-year university student who works part-time at a karaoke shop. One day, he encounters a female customer who used to be a children's TV singer. She pleads with him, saying, "If you don't mind, could you listen to just one song?" and "Honestly, I want to sing in front of children again, just like I used to..." Though puzzled, Tsukasa agrees. The woman turns out to be an incredible singer, but despite performing children's songs, for some reason, her singing is irresistibly sexy...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: カラオケで歌うおねえさんといっしょ
title.romaji: Karaoke de Utau Onee-san to Issho

187714.description:
"Hey, don't you want to see what's under my uniform? You can do whatever you want, you know?"

After school, in an empty classroom where nobody is around. Taking a selfie with her uniform disheveled in a lewd pose is Shinomiya Rinoa, the pure and beautiful "school princess."

Her alluring appearance was different from her usual self, and even though I knew it was wrong, I ended up pressing the shutter-- click.

"Anno-kun, did you get a good picture?"

She found out. I have no choice but to prepare for social death...

"...Could you take a picture of me in a more embarrassing pose?"
"...What did you say?"

Why did it turn out like this? I ended up having a secret photoshoot with Rinoa!? Changing into her school uniform in my room, a competitive swimsuit in the bathroom, and then at her house── A secret, heart-pounding romantic comedy begins from a single photo!
synonyms: The School Princess Who Shyly Shows Me Her Embarrassed Side in Secret

title.native: こそっと恥じらう姿を俺だけに見せてくる学園のお姫さま
title.romaji: Kosotto Hajirau Sugata wo Ore Dake ni Misetekuru Gakuen no Ohime-sama

187715.description:
Yeong, nicknamed “Contest God” for her middle school wins, faces a chaotic start to high school when a contest with a huge prize is announced. The catch? It requires a six-person team. After a class project forces Yeong, her best friend Hana, and four unlikely teammates together, Yeong learns about the challenges of teamwork. But when the prize money doubles, the mismatched group decides to enter, sparking drama and unexpected bonds. Will they find success -- and maybe something more?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.native: 痛いのは嫌なので防御力に極振りしたいと思います。外伝
title.romaji: Itai no wa Iya nano de Bougyoryoku ni Kyokufuri Shitai to Omoimasu. Gaiden

187717.description: There was a young gladiator girl who was famous in the Colosseum, her name is "Invincible Sword" Ramune. Ramune was bought as a slave, but unexpectedly became free due to a horse-drawn carriage accident. A girl that doesn't know what "normal" is, lives her life by seeing the world, learning, and being touched by the kindness of people.

187718.description:
Yoowon has always been in her twin sister, Heekyung's, shadow. Heekyung even holds the heart of the man Yoowon loves in the palm of her hand. Self-conscious and insecure, Yoowon knows she will never be enough to win his affection. But a spicy one-night stand with a new man opens her eyes to possibilities for a life outside of her sister’s shadow and in the arms of a handsome, confident CEO. But how will the world react to a bold new Yoowon when Jaejoon helps her see her real potential?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: เสน่หาพ่ายรัก

title.romaji: Tensai Madougushi wa Souki Retired Mezashite Ganbarimasu

187722.description:
After working herself to the bone for a shady company, poor Kasumi died from overworking! But if she thinks she's getting a break in the afterlife, she's got another thing coming. Right when she's about to start her second life, she's suddenly pushed into a job-as a substitute goddess! Thankfully, she has the help of the very capable angel, Mashiro, who will guide her through this new responsibility. But is she really the right person for the job to deal with other reincarnated souls-and their personalities?!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: 女神のおしごと!～限界女子、異世界で女神はじめました～
title.romaji: Megami no Oshigoto! Genkai Joshi, Isekai de Megami Hajimemashita

187725.description:
In the mystical realm of Hoseon, protected by the tiger deity known as the Sable Tiger, Crown Prince Lee Hyo is born with formidable power but a cold, foreboding aura that forces the palace to hide his existence. Meanwhile, Seo Doram, a disgraced noble turned servant, is unexpectedly summoned to the palace with an astonishing decree: he is to become the Crown Princess. Confused and suspicious, Doram finds himself entangled in royal secrets, while the aloof prince oddly recalls a bond from their childhood... Just what could the Sable Tiger have in store for them both?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Please come down and give me your blessings

Gobbling up a small one. ♥

187729.description:
Myeong-Ha’s beloved boyfriend Tae-On—her pride and everything—has died, leaving behind a will addressed to his friend Jeong-U: “I leave all my assets to my beloved girlfriend.” But there’s a twist—Tae-On had not one, but three girlfriends. Under Jeong-U’s supervision, a quiet yet intense battle unfolds. With 3 billion won at stake, only one can inherit it all. Who will emerge as the “beloved girlfriend,” and what truths will surface as each woman stakes her claim?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.romaji: OneShota Doujin Sakka Mama no Himitsu

187731.description:
Hatano is a normal high school girl who finds Reimu Iwashita, a beautiful transfer student, entering her class one day. Hatano grows suspicious when Ishida and Kamiya, two otaku in her class with communication problems, act friendly with Reimu. Following the three to the old school building, she comes to learn an unexpected secret about the transfer student.

(Source: Asahi Shimbun Shuppan, translated)
synonyms: Maiden Golem and Weirdos of Science Room
Shojo goremu to rika-shitsu no henjin-tach

title.native: 少女ゴーレムと理科室の変人たち
title.romaji: Shoujo Golem to Rika-shitsu no Henjin-tachi

187732.description:
The familiar duo of Quart, a psychic medium specializing in animals, and a half-black cat travel back in time to New York in the roaring 1920s during the Prohibition Era!? A man with an eyepatch appears before them in a state of panic! Quart knew him well enough!?

(Source: Amazon, translated)
synonyms: Gurasu no Hahen wa Neko no Tameiki

title.native: グラスの破片は猫のため息
title.romaji: Glass no Hahen wa Neko no Tameiki

187733.description:
Anzu Nakamori came to Tokyo from a farmhouse in Aomori, dreaming of becoming an amazing model. When she arrives in Tokyo with her head full of dreams, she is delighted to discover that the stylish place she's going to live is a shared house! But when she opens the door to her new home, she finds a man standing there shirtless! An odd first meeting, but one that could lead to something interesting...

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title.native: 綾城くんは秘密を守りたい～これ、先輩の裏アカですか？～
title.romaji: Ayajo-kun wa Himitsu wo Mamoritai: Kore, Senpai no Ura Aka desu ka?

title.native: 略奪使いの成り上がり～追放された男は、最高の仲間と英雄を目指す～
title.romaji: Ryakudatsu Tsukai no Nariagari: Tsuiho Sareta Otoko wa, Saiko no Nakama to Eiyuu wo Mezasu

title.native: カノンレディ 〜砲兵令嬢戦記〜

187741.description:
Asil, a poor noble, enters the academy as the top student, determined to restore his family’s honor. Instead, he becomes the target of relentless bullying. Seeking justice, he confronts Valery, only to face an even harsher fate. Reduced to Valery’s pawn and isolated from everyone, Asil searches desperately for a way out. But Valery’s growing obsession only tightens the chains around him.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

187742.description:
After ten long years of engagement to Gilbert Norman, heir to a ducal house, Seara Elliot, daughter of a humble viscount, finally makes up her mind-it's time to call it off! Though her heart still belongs to Gilbert, his distant attitude toward her and the gentle smiles he offers to other women have convinced Seara that she's not the one he wants. If setting him free means his happiness, then so be it. Rather than cling to a hopeless love, Seara decides to let him go with grace. But to her astonishment, Gilbert refuses! Completely bewildered, Seara begins to question everything: his intentions, his feelings, and the truth behind his cold facade. Determined to secure his happiness one way or another, she sets out on a mission: to find and recommend the perfect bride to take her place... even if her heart hasn't quite caught up with the idea yet.

(Source: Crossed Hearts)

title.english: The Matchmaker’s Fiancé: My Fiancé Won't Leave Me Alone While I'm Finding Him the Ideal Bride
title.native: 『理想の花嫁を探して幸せにして差し上げます』と言ったら、そっけなかった婚約者が何故か関わってきますが、花嫁斡旋頑張ります
title.romaji: "Risou no Hanayome wo Sagashite Shiawase ni Shite Sashiagemasu" to Ittara, Sokkenakatta Konyakusha ga Nazeka Kankawa tte Kimasu ga, Hanayome Assen Ganbarimasu

187743.description:
Seo Do-Gyeom, the young master of a mansion, and Yoon Seo-Won, the housekeeper's son, share a secret bond despite their different social statuses. After a kiss, Seo-Won falls in love, but Do-Gyeom abruptly leaves to study abroad. Five years later, Seo-Won, now an adult, is about to leave the mansion when Do-Gyeom returns and offers him a role as his pheromone partner.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 皇太子と婚約したら余命が10年に縮んだので、謎解きはじめます!
title.romaji: Koutaishi to Konyaku Shitara Yomei ga 10-nen ni Chinjinda node, Nazo Toki Hajimemasu!

187745.description:
A manipulative man uses vulnerable women for his own gain, hiding behind kindness. Will the true cost of his actions come to light?

(Source: Toomics)

187746.description:
A landlady offers her friend's younger brother a tempting deal. But when more people enter the picture, things get more complicated.

(Source: Toomics)

187750.description:
After his wife dies in a plane crash, a widower falls into despair. But when a new neighbor moves in next door—looking eerily like his late wife—his world is shaken. Is it just a coincidence, or could she really be her reincarnation? As they grow closer, the mystery deepens.

(Source: Toomics)

187753.description:
After contracting a virus, Bill becomes one of the Gifted, a secret group of humans with supernatural abilities.

(Source: Toomics)

187755.description:
So-Hwa, a goblin living in an old library. Yun-Woo, who is in love with So-Hwa, makes a contract to share his soul in order to be with her. Repeated reincarnations, an uncontrollable and mismatched relationship. Will Yun-Woo and So-Hwa be able to love again?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Sunaemul Danpyeonseon (순애물 단편선) Collection.

187756.description:
The female diver, Somyeong, has an unexpected encounter with Yeo-Hae, a merman, in the depths of the sea. While wielding a sickle, she accidentally strikes him. In the chaos, Somyeong loses consciousness, only to later awaken and discover that Yeo-Hae, despite the injury, had saved her life. Stricken with guilt for causing him harm, Somyeong decides to bring the injured merman back to her home, hoping to tend to his wounds and make amends. However, as she begins to treat him, she finds herself swept up in Yeo-Hae's rut. What started as a rescue soon transforms into an unexpected and irresistible encounter.

Note: Part of Lezhin's Sunaemul Danpyeonseon (순애물 단편선) Collection.

187757.description:
Lucian is a royal princess by day and the infamous "Phantom Princess" by night. To ruin her upcoming arranged marriage to Prince Heveron, she sneaks into his chambers to rob him blind and vanish. Too bad her fiancé just took a very strange potion. Waking up in a horny haze, Heveron mistakes Lucian’s midnight robbery for a lucid dream and decides to play along, starting with a scorching kiss. Now, the clumsy thief is trapped under her muscular fiancé, wondering if she'll manage to steal his treasure or if he’s going to steal her heart instead.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Sunaemul Danpyeonseon (순애물 단편선) Collection.

187758.description:
“When I’m with you… I feel at ease, Joy. Only after you came here did I feel as though I was truly alive…”

Duke Ron has always been a loner his whole life. That is, until he met the maid, Joy. Seeing how she never fears him despite his cold and guarded personality, he starts opening up to her, feeling as if she's saved him from his loneliness. Little does he know that she’s not who he thinks she is…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Sunaemul Danpyeonseon (순애물 단편선) Collection.

187759.description:
After a long day at work, all she wanted was a moment of rest on a park bench. But when she closed her eyes, she awoke in a different place—and now, whenever she goes to sleep, she wakes up, trapped in a tiny room with a towering man whose wild, animalistic presence sends a shiver down her spine. Every night, she finds herself beneath him, powerless against the pleasure and confusion he brings. Is it a dream? A different world? Or something in between? As the boundary between reality and fantasy begins to blur, a strange and all-consuming romance unfolds—one that defies time, reason, and her very sense of self.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

187760.description:
Jihoon never believed in love at first sight until he met Seolhee, the undefeated boxing prodigy. What surprises him even more is how the strongest girl in the ring can be so cute.

(Source: Toomics)

187761.description:
By day, ordinary people. By night, secret desires pull them into forbidden temptations.

(Source: Toomics)

At Dawn, in the Convenience Store

187764.description:
The gym is a great place to get in shape… but some workouts feel better done behind closed doors.

(Source: Toomics)

title.english: Training in All the Right Ways

187765.description:
Steamy stories that might be true...or totally fake. Hooking up with your married friend? A wild foursome out of nowhere? Who hasn’t fantasized about something a little out there? New episodes every day to tease your curiosity—until the big reveal. Can you tell what's fact and what's pure fantasy? Take your best guess...if you dare.

(Source: Lezhin US)

187766.description:
"I like you! Have sex with me!"

Seon-Ung, a new hire at a large company, has come across a program that changes what constitutes common sense for the people around him. He decides to use his newfound skill to teach his team leader a lesson for giving him a hard time over the past 4 years.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Sasha-chan is Addicted to Having Hardcore Sex When She's Majorly Stressed Out.

I've been beaten and humilated all my life and I even lost my parents.

"Now it's your turn. Don't expect to get out of this easily."

187774.description:
Alicia, daughter of a prestigious noble family, was the most hated girl at the academy. After her rival stole her fiancé and a tragic accident claimed her life, she's reincarnated in another world by a goddess—only to discover she was the villainess in an otome game! Her naturally fierce and headstrong personality still overwhelms everyone around her, but mysteriously, in this new reality everyone can't help but like her...?! Even in this reverse reincarnation, our villainess refuses to compromise who she is! A heart-pounding academy romance where she conquers both love and stays true to her beliefs!!

187777.description:
High schooler Luna Amano can barely recall the last 5 years of her life. Her older sister promised to help Luna make new memories—until one day, she vanished. Alone with few memories to cling to, Luna dedicates herself to keeping up her sister's shop in hopes she one day returns. After receiving threats from her yakuza landlord, Luna returns home one day to find the flower shop up in flames! Suddenly, everything shifts, and hazy memories flood her mind. In a flash, Luna goes from seeing red to painting the streets red with blood. She doesn't know why she's so capable with a gun, but what she does know is that she will not forgive the men who started the fire.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

After that, she uses her modern scientific knowledge to overcome the troubles that come her way, and before she knows it, she has become a very important person, known as the "Witch" or the "Savior"!

The editor-in-chief, Maki Ishikawa, is kind to co-workers, good at her job, and acts like the ideal boss! But in front of her junior colleague, Nodoka Minami, she starts acting strangely.

"Maki-senpai, I can always count on you!" Minami says with a big smile.
Maki wants to get to know Minami better, but she is worried, "Would it be harassment to ask for her phone number?"
“Is it be too much if I ask her out to lunch?" she wonders…
Aah!!! She definitely doesn't want come across like a creep, but she wishes they could be be friends!

In a time when humanity has left Earth and migrated to other planets in the galaxy, two unrelated people, Mads, a Martian whose life is threatened by the mafia, and Vigne, a Venusian who is the galaxy's greatest diva, meet each other due to a mysterious "orb" that fell from space. They are unaware that this is a sign of a major event that will shake the solar system. This is the start of a thrilling and entertaining sci-fi manga with a last-century view of the universe!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

187818.description:
Jeong Da-Um is a beta. There’s nothing wrong with that, per se, but it’s what drives him to quit his job as an idol to become a manager at an entertainment agency. There, he’s determined to live an ordinary life, but that’s pretty hard to do when you become the manager of Lee Yeon, an actor with a large fan following and an even larger reputation as a prickly alpha. When Yeon goes into an unexpected rut, Da-Um’s life very quickly starts getting out of the ordinary...

(Source: Lezhin US)

187819.description:
Searching for his lost love, handsome vampire Zacha turns up at the home of the elderly Tsugumi and her granddaughters Yumeko and Himari. Thrilled by the arrival of a real-life vampire in her humdrum town, Yumeko is eager to help Zacha, but as they piece together the extraordinary life story of the woman he loved, Yumeko begins unearthing her own family secrets.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

187820.description:
A high school boy died and was reborn as a chomper.
He originally thought he could bask in the sun, drink water and lie down every day, but he discovered that as a plant from another world, he was in danger of being eaten by monsters or poached by hunters to refine medicine at any time.
Fortunately, he has his own "flower" system, which continuously integrates the characteristics of other plants, and eventually evolved into the guardian immortal plant of the Giant Continent.

(Source: Iqiyi, translated)
synonyms: Reborn as a Big Mouth Flower

187821.description:
After a year of dating, Russian mafia boss Vasily Kaminsky and money launderer Yoon Yuno face an unexpected crisis when Vasily is injured, losing all but his memories from when he was 18. Reverting to the cold, ruthless man he once was, Vasily denies their relationship and cruelly pushes Yuno away. Heartbroken, Yuno contemplates walking away for good. But despite his harsh words, Vasily begins to cling to Yuno. Now, Yuno faces an impossible choice: leave before Vasily’s memories return, or stay and risk his heart for a love that might no longer exist.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes the prologue.

187822.description:
In a rough neighborhood where police rarely intervene, Nabi runs a quiet little hair salon. But behind her sweet appearance lies a deadly secret: she's a man-eating monster who only targets intruders, specifically sexual predators. With her "supply" running low, Nabi captures an unexpected trespasser, a contract killer named Kang Eunchan who was sent to assassinate her. Before he knows it, he's overpowered and locked away in her secret underground shelter. As Nabi begins to care for him in her own strange way, Eunchan finds himself reluctantly drawn to her and even offers himself up as her next meal. Between a beautiful predator and a killer too charming to eat, their twisted relationship begins to spiral, just as other men start appearing with their own reasons for wanting to fall under Nabi's control. A sharp, bloody love thriller with one hell of a bite.

(Source: Lezhin US)

187823.description:
Sanae Kitajima is a psychiatrist specializing in end-of-life care. Her boyfriend, Takanashi, who once struggled with a deep fear of death, returns from an Amazon expedition profoundly changed. What happened during the expedition? What is the true meaning behind his cryptic words, "I can hear the whispers of angels"?

(Source: Asahi Shimbun Shuppan, translated)

187863.description:
"How can my past self get so excited doing all those embarrassing things!?"

When he was in the third year of middle school, Hizaki Shiou was summoned to another world to save it. After defeating the Demon King, he was forcibly returned back to the present day. Yet another three years later, he is summoned to the other world once again, this time to stop the rampage of the secret society "Helheim."

That organization was supposedly actually the one that he had founded during his chuunibyou phase, where he called himself the "Corpse King"—a dark past too embarrassing to remember! Someone seems to be impersonating the name of "Helheim" and tarnishing its reputation. To uncover the truth behind this mystery and clear the organization's name, the Corpse King reunites with his former subordinates, the "Hakkai," who once made Helheim the strongest it had ever been. While agonizing over his dark past, he begins to take action in the other world once again.

Their first stop is the Steel City of Gagiul—rescue the city struggling through famine as well as the pale-looking count's daughter in distress.

"Helheim, moving out.

187872.description:
A lifelong game-addict healer with decades of experience. By chance, the world changed, and I became the only healer in existence. [A place that needs you, the one and only healer, has summoned you.]

[Will you accept the summons?] "What? They have tanks and DPS but no healer?" Seriously, what kind of broken game balance is this?

[The constellations observing you protest indignantly: "This isn’t a game—it’s reality!"] Decades have passed since the Gates first appeared. I’d heard they’d accumulated plenty of strategies and data by now, but— "Why is everyone so inefficient? It’s infuriating."

As someone obsessed with optimal strategies, I focused solely on obliterating the Gates. But then— "You’re the one who saved me. You made it so I can’t see anyone but you." — A betrayed former No. 1 ranker who became a recluse: "I need you. My savior. My life." —The leader of the world’s top 10 guild alliance: "Don’t abandon me. I can’t even breathe without you." —The current No. 1 ranker: "I’m already drowning in Gate raids, but now these strange people won’t leave me alone."

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: I Became the Only Healer in This World

187873.description:
Haise is a young boy who has been gifted with an unknown ability. He becomes an adventurer together with his childhood friend Sasha, but is kicked out of the team for being unable to use his ability and being a hindrance. Furthermore, while continuing his solo adventure, he is caught in a trap and falls into dire straits.

Just as he is on the brink of death, Haise's ability "Weapon Master" awakens! It is a power that shakes the laws of the world, summoning weapons from another world!? An unrivaled fantasy set in another world that begins with adversity!

(Source: SB Creative, translated)

Hong Heejoo is a sign language interpreter who has become mute due to severe depression. She and her husband never exchanged a single conversation for the three years of their arranged marriage. One day, her life takes a harrowing turn when she's taken hostage. "Don't hang up! This isn't a phishing call...!" However, her husband, who was even worse than a stranger, coldly disconnected the call. "Call me when a body is found."

Enraged, Heejoo decides to strike back. She'll threaten her husband anonymously, no matter the cost. But there's a twist: her target is the notorious Blue House spokesperson, a man known for his biting sarcasm.

As the threats escalate, Heejoo begins to question her own sanity. Is this really the same man she married? And why does this twisted game feel so strangely exhilarating?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Call You Just Made Is

Just as the shift begins to weigh on his mind, he wakes one night to an eerie touch and soft lips brushing against his skin—only to find Haesu, flushed and possessed, staring at him with an unfamiliar intensity....

(Source: Lezhin US)

And yet Louis still finds teachers he respects and friends he can rely on as he grows into the man who will become a Sage. Learn all about the notorious deeds of the Barrier Mage's youth in this prequel to Secrets of the Silent Witch.

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: サイレント・ウィッチ -another- 結界の魔術師の成り上がり
title.romaji: Secrets of the Silent Witch -another- Kekkai no Majutsushi no Nariagari

187881.description:
Clark, a vampire who had been sleeping for 800 years, was dug out by the young Taoist Jiang Lai and successfully bound to a contract. Trying to find a way to kill this vampire, Jiang Lai starts living with her and tries various methods, but she ends up falling for Clark's seductive charm. A chance encounter turns out to be an inevitable reunion… In that past life and in this one, the one who hated her is reborn. Love and hate are like the two sides of the moon. "Clark, come to me."

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: Kiss Me in The Dark of Night

187882.description:
After a missed connection years ago, office worker Mizuho developed an irresistible craving for deep, sultry voices. With such a unique fetish, she’s been on the hunt for that perfect tone to satisfy her desires. When she meets Hibino, a handsome salesman with a voice that’s smooth as velvet, at a company drinking party, Mizuho can’t help but melt. Captivated by his seductive timbre, she invites him back to her place, where just a single suggestive whisper sends her senses into overdrive. Is Hibino the passionate partner she’s been waiting for, or will her hopes for a true connection fall on deaf ears?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: His Sensual Whisper: The Voice That Sets Me On Fire
title.native: 隣の上司は絶倫イケボ　～耳からイッちゃう甘濡れセックス
title.romaji: Tonari no Joushi wa Zetsurin Ikebo: Mimi kara Icchau Amanure Sex

187883.description:
"I sold myself that day—"

A man and a woman kiss each other in a foreign land amidst turbulent times. This is the story of a couple who, buffeted by the stormy waves of history, loved each other through their dreams for freedom. The husband is a Portuguese merchant. The wife is a Japanese "slave."

Tatsu, a timid young girl, chases after Shino, her childhood friend, and finds herself aboard a trading ship in the Nagasaki harbor, where she meets Leo, a fearless young man. She is forced to the bottom of the ship as a slave, and is threatened by the vile acts of the ship's crew…?

(Source: Futabanet, translated)

title.native: アスチルベ～船底の花嫁～

187884.description:
Café barista Hayase Hinako lives with her handsome fiancé Kagaya Seiya, a hotshot lawyer she met in her coffee shop. He's everything she could ever want in a future husband: sweet, caring, and handy in the kitchen as well as in the bedroom. But just when she thinks it's all smooth sailing, her loving partner transforms from a gentleman into a tyrant overnight! He may look the same on the outside, but he's not the Seiya she knows and loves…so who is he?!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Chapter count includes three Intermission and three Postscript chapters.

title.native: 二人の婚約者に溺愛されて

187885.description:
"I just want to lose my virginity" — so why am I kissing my male childhood friend…?

Yuu is THE average student who wants to have a girlfriend and experience new things. When he talks to his friends about it, they tease him by telling him to do it with his childhood friend Chiharu. The problem is, Chiharu is a guy!

When Yuu tells Chiharu about their comments, Chiharu says, "Sounds fun, why don't we play lovers?"
Yuu is disappointed that his best friend is joining in on the teasing.
Yuu says, “But I want to do all this with my girlfriend: date, hold hands, hug, and kiss."

At first, they just touch gently, but Chiharu's kisses become more intense and more insistent, and before they know it, their bodies are starting to get hot and bothered...

(Source: NuPu Comics, translated)

187886.description:
1. Tenshi wo Tsukamaeta (Caging an Angel)
2-3. Natsu-kun Daisuki! (I Love You, Natsu-kun!)
4. Shinkon Gokko (Pretend Newlyweds)
5. Senzoku♀Shitsuji (Personal♀Butler)
6. Goshiyou Omachi Shitemasu♥ (Waiting To Be Used♥)
7. Mendokusai tte Iwanaide! (Don't Call Me Annoying!)
8. Mukuchi na Kanojo (Silent Girlfriend)

title.native: にくしょくショートケーキ

187887.description:
Lee Han, an unknown actor with crazy acting skills but never seen the light of day. He saves the lead actor Kang Tae-Yoon on a filming set where an accident occurred and dies in his place, but when he wakes up, he has become 'Cha Si-Han' with the beauty of the other world... "The ratings, the articles, the reactions, they're all the best. The drama that was on the verge of failure has come back to life, thanks to Si-Han." Si-Han, who suddenly gained attention in a drama where he appeared as a supporting role, is suddenly subdued by someone with great force on his way home. "Mr. Cha Si-Han. You know me, right?" His breathing stopped as his heart dropped. The man, Kang Tae-Yoon, was looking at him and smiling brightly.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

187888.description:
Choi Joo-Ha is a professional baseball player for the Hunters when his high school hoobae, Park Do-Jin, joins the team. The two spent their youth kissing, but didn't go any further than that. One day, Dojin drags Joo-Ha into a bathroom stall, lamenting how they never did more and is determined to make up for lost time. Will Ju-Ha be able to balance both his personal and professional life, or will Do-Jin's brash behavior shove them both into the public eye?

(Source: Lezhin US)

187889.description:
After six years of marriage, this hardworking couple barely sees each other due to mismatched work schedules. Despite their busy lives, they've found the ultimate secret to keeping their love alive—late-night drinks together! From sharing a quiet toast to getting a little too tipsy, their drunken heart-to-hearts keep their bond strong and their passion burning. Can a little alcohol be the cure for a fading spark? A heartwarming and hilarious tipsy romance about love, laughter, and liquor!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)
synonyms: The Secret to a Happy Marriage Is Drinking Together at Night

title.native: 夫婦のヒケツは晩酌です
title.romaji: Fuufu no Hiketsu wa Banshaku desu

187891.description:
Noa Mukanae is a member of the Vtuber idol group "Hoshigaoka High School."

Gou Karube, one of Noa's well-known fans, is a high school student who spends his youth in order to support his favorite idol.

Thanks to the continuous support of her fans, she was able hold a solo live concert. The time has finally come where she could make her dream come true together with her fans... or so it should have been.

A manga serialization about producing a good ending for your "oshi."
187891.hashtag: #Vエン #VTuberのエンディング #VTuberのエンディング買い取ります

title.native: VTuberのエンディング、買い取ります。

187893.description:
Lucien, the notorious eldest son of House Hevonshire, is suddenly forced into a political marriage after years of scandalous behavior disgrace his family. On the eve of the wedding, he indulges in one last night of excess and accepts a drink from a mysterious stranger. Soon after, Lucien loses control of his body and is claimed by a man whose intentions seem anything but coincidental. When morning comes, Lucien is left with fragmented memories, a lingering presence, and the unsettling realization that someone has been waiting for him far longer than he ever knew.

(Source: Lezhin US)

187894.description:
Blessed be the devout who remain chaste among the tainted. A pious young debutante of the Kingdom of Brandt, Elke Eberhardt prays each day as she vies for the sacred title of Pontifex, which grants authority over the nation’s faith. Unfortunately for Elke, fate has other, crueler plans—as she catches the eye of Sir Reiner Mikhel, a notorious womanizer who has seduced countless noblewomen in Brandt. Despite her firm resolve to remain virtuous, Elke finds herself increasingly drawn to the temptations of this dark, ambitious nobleman, whose seductive gaze conceals his true intentions.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ด่างพร้อยที่ร้อยรัก
誰でも入る穴〜私をちょっと手伝ってくれますか〜

187896.description:
University student Juno is handsome and smart, so everyone has always just assumed he's an alpha, even though he's still unsure of his secondary gender. One day, he unexpectedly meets another alpha, who boldly declares, "You're mine, now!" Juno, enraged by the audacity, snaps back at him. However, Juno soon finds himself forced to share a room with that arrogant alpha Riku. Every day, Riku pursues him, claiming he fell in love with Juno at first sight, even as Juno continues to brush him off. But when Juno begins to react to Riku's alpha nature, he unexpectedly realizes that he's actually an omega…!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Omae, Ore no Mon ni Nare!

187897.description:
Hayasaka, talented and handsome but with a haughty attitude, is known as the "Prince" of the company. However, despite his looks and skills, he has never beaten his even more perfect work rival, Shindo, ever since joining the company. To his surprise, Shindo makes an unexpectedly serious confession of his feelings for him.

"I'll break up with him at the peak of our relationship, make him feel down, and take the top sales spot for myself."

Seeing it as a chance to overcome his rival, Hayasaka, though feeling a slight pang of guilt, agrees to start a relationship with Shindo. Being inexperienced in love, Hayasaka never anticipated what would come next… A serious relationship means dates, kisses, and maybe even more—!?

(Source: Brite Shuppan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ちょろかわ王子のニセ恋人作戦
title.romaji: Chorokawa Ouji no Nise Koibito Sakusen

187898.description:
"Now, both of us are murderers!"

Kaede, who works as an unassuming janitor, and Ryo, who leads a decadent life as a kept man, were once childhood friends. They share a secret neither of them dare reveal to anyone else. After eight years, they reunite. Kaede, having killed someone for Ryo, desperately runs away with him, caught up by their passionately desire for each another. As they flee, Ryo’s past sins begin to surface. Bound by a deep love for each other, but both stained by blood. Will their journey lead them to salvation, or will it be their downfall?

(Source: J-Publishing, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

187899.description:
1. The extra chapter depicts a night of forgetting everything and indulging in intense costume play.
2. This extra chapter depicts their first encounter and subsequent one-night stand, in a world where neither Ryo nor Kaede “killed anyone.”

(Source: J-Publishing, translated)

187900.description:
1. Housenka Pan (ほうせんか・ぱん)
2. Ame no Oto ga Kikoeru (雨の音がきこえる)
3. Shichigatsu Nanoka ni (七月七日に)
4. Apostrophe S (アポストロフィーＳ)

Note: Contains the illustrated poem Love Poem (ラブ ・ポエム), and the illustrated short story Page One (ページワン).

187902.description:
Detectives Alexander Poe and Quarter Watson investigate strange incidents.

Note: Chapter count includes the prologue.

187903.description:
A collection of yuri horror short stories.

Note: Chapter count includes the prologue.

187904.description:
Number is not your average serial killer. Equipped with the ability to identify future murderers, Number takes the law into his own hands. He believes in ridding the world of destined killers. Simple, right? One day, he runs into Ji-Hyeon, whose number changes constantly as she develops a special power of her own. Will the two work together to eliminate would-be murderers? Or will Ji-Hyeon's very existence threaten Number's moral compass?

(Source: WEBTOON)

187905.description:
A hard-boiled fantasy set in a Japan that has declined due to climate change, food crisis, and AI collapse, depicting the team-up of a blind ex-detective and his robot dog companion. Jin Yuzuriha, a former detective who lost his sight in a serious accident, has the power to see the existence of "Kakuri" in the hidden world. One day, while investigating a car accident that is suspected to be related to Kakuri, Jin becomes a partner of Idin, a police dog robot modeled after a German shepherd, to assist his vision in the real world.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 東京潮汐 トーキョー・タイド

187907.description:
Sosuke Nezuchi and Yoshiki Yoshiko work for a seemingly ordinary transport company, Mujina Transport. However, their customers are all non-humans, in other words, youkai. The reason for this is that the company is a "courier specializing in youkai"?　

What are the mysterious requests of these mysterious youkai living in secret?

(Source: Nemuki+ Comics, translated)

187910.description:
Koh Yang-Seo, the star center fielder for the Servals, always treated his junior teammate, Kang Ha-Joo, like a younger brother—until he discovered Ha-Joo’s secret: he’s gay. When Yang-Seo catches him using a dating app, he becomes overly protective, determined to keep an eye on his innocent junior. But his watchful eye leads to unexpected closeness: the same team, the same field, and now... the same bed?!

Wait a second. Something’s definitely off here...!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Notes: Part of Blühen's Hageukasang (하극상) Short Story Collection or Downfall Collection in English.
synonyms: [Hageuksang Short Story Collection] Run and Hit

187911.description:
Falsely accused through a shadowy adversary’s deliberate scheme, Dominic, the patriarch of house Winters, faces the imminent downfall of his entire family. As he struggles to find a way to save his family name, a secretive and highly dangerous proposal is made—one that demands his body as collateral...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Blühen's Hageukasang (하극상) Short Story Collection or Downfall Collection in English.
synonyms: [Hageuksang Short Story Collection] To You in My Hands
[Downfall Collection] Bound by Duty, Torn by Pride

title.english: Bound by Duty, Torn by Pride

187912.description:
Elementary school teacher Gi-Jeong Go has lost almost everything: her parents when she was a child, her freedom when she had to support her shut-in younger brother, and now her very dignity as the class bully among her students and his mother threaten to turn her life into a living hell. Upon meeting the mild-mannered yet inscrutable lawyer In-Seop Oh, Gi-Jeong begins to find her life changing, though little does she know that wherever In-Seop goes, death follows…

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

187913.description:
An alpha terrified of other alphas meets a proud omega. Their undestined love begins with a fake relationship contract.
Aka, the top-ranked omega at his club, one day gets requested by Soei, a rich heir way out of his element. Aka's more than excited to land a wealthy client, but it all goes downhill when Soei's sympathetic look enrages him instead. In this world, alphas are said to be superior, but Aka is certain that it's the other way around... omegas are the ones who really rule the world!
The two spend a night together, surrendering to their instincts and losing their senses. Soei takes a liking to Aka and, to the latter's dismay, then introduces him to his parents as his fated pair.
It turns out, Soei just wants to get out of an unwanted arranged marriage. He pleads and presents Aka with a lucrative fake partnership contract. Does this mean Aka will finally have to face the one thing he's evaded his whole life ― fate!?

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.
synonyms: No. 1 Omega-sama wa Unmei wo Shinjinai
The Ω Doesn't Believe in Destiny
The Omega Doesn't Believe in Destiny
No.1 오메가 님은 운명을 믿지 않아

title.english: The Top-Ranked Omega Doesn't Believe In Destiny
title.native: No.1オメガ様は運命を信じない
title.romaji: No.1 Omega-sama wa Unmei wo Shinjinai

187915.description:
An incident occurred in the confectionery club of a certain school. Who was the culprit who broke the macarons intended for competition? A female student and a girl detective, "Kinako,'' roam the school in pursuit of a mystery.

(Source: Nemuki+ Comics, translated)

187916.description:
Shin, a Japanese assistant, travels with Ferrier, a famous university professor. Professors who are known by UNESCO and other organizations visit sites aiming to be registered as World Heritage Sites, and sometimes receive bribes. However, Shin has a purpose for traveling with such a professor!

(Source: Nemuki+ Comics, translated)

title.native: クイーン オブ ディストピア

187917.description:
A heart-pounding long-distance romance for adults!! Nobuko, who works at an airport, and Tsuburaya, a pilot. While they're spending sweet time together, Nobuko is transferred...! "We'll be fine together." Nobuko starts a new life with those words in her heart, but...?

(Source: Office YOU, translated)

title.native: 今日きみの手をとってあの空の下
title.romaji: Kyou Kimi no Te wo Totte Ano Sora no Shita

187919.description:
René pays a visit to Dr. Hoop to have his broken toy robot repaired. There, a real-life wind-up robot makes a surprise appearance and requests for Dr. Hoop to come and repair the generator that powers all of Robot Country–and the robots, too–saving them all. With the wind-up robot leading the way, the ragtag group makes their way 600 meters below ground—destination: Robot Country!

(Source: Fukuinkan Shoten, translated)

187920.description:
Ichitaro Amamiya, a bullied child, received an e-mail. It was an invitation to play “CHIMES,” an online game where game over means death in real life! A school fantasy where the virtual and the real intersect!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

187922.description:
A booklet packaged with Harta volume 121 at select stores. It's an anthology of one-shots centering on the theme of cigarettes.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: シガレットフェローズ

187923.description: An omnibus containing all three versions of Kamen Rider ZX.

187926.description:
“Why do you keep making me misunderstand you like this!? My affection level can’t go any higher than this, you know!?” (← said by the princess with the greatest beauty in the kingdom)

The puppy-like beautiful girl sitting next to me who’s grown attached to me… turns out she’s actually a princess.

I'm Heim, and I enrolled as a scholarship student in a magic academy full of nobles.

Unbothered by being looked down on as a commoner, I devoted myself to honing my magic—until one day, I accidentally learned the national secret of the princess’s true identity.

While carrying this secret, I end up pretending to be her lover to protect her from the arrogant nobles targeting her.

“Heim-kun, I want to be with you! I want to, I want to, I want to, I want to!”

Alone together, close enough to touch with homemade bentos. In front of me alone, the princess’s demeanor grows sweeter and sweeter—

A royally sugary love comedy begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: The Princess Sitting Next to Me Is My Girlfriend Who is Only Sweet Towards Me

title.native: 隣の席の王女様、俺の前だけ甘々カノジョ
title.romaji: Tonari no Seki no Oujo-sama, Ore no Mae dake Amaama Kanojo

187927.description:
Thanks to the government’s romance encouragement policy, all high school students are casually enjoying love through a school-exclusive matching app.

Amid this, Kuga Renji, who gets so nervous around girls that his whole body stiffens, has been branded with an F-rank on the app and is living days filled with despair. One day, by chance, Renji ends up helping the number one S-rank girl, Hoshinose Airi.

In exchange for teaching Airi household chores, Renji begins receiving personal love lessons from her. With his inherent earnestness and eagerness to learn, Renji’s love power levels up in no time!

As Airi watches Renji by his side, her own heart begins to soften…

“I’m glad it was you who found out about my weakness.”

A youthful romantic comedy about conquering love with an S-rank beauty!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 三人のライバル令嬢のうち“ハズレ令嬢”に転生したようです。～前世は病弱でしたが、癒しの魔法で今度は私が助けます！～
title.romaji: Sannin no Rival Reijou no Uchi "Hazure Reijou" ni Tensei Shita you desu. Zense wa Byoujaku deshita ga, Iyashi no Mahou de Kondo wa Watashi ga Tasukemasu

title.native: 当て馬大好きセシリアちゃん ～ヒロインの姉に転生したので、負けヒーローの推しを救います～
title.romaji: Ateuma Daisuki Cecilia-chan: Heroine no Ane ni Tensei Shita node, Make Hero no Oshi wo Sukuimasu

title.native: 身体は児童、中身はおっさんの成り上がり冒険記 サテラもついて行きます！
title.romaji: Karada wa Kodomo, Nakami wa Ossan no Nariagari Boukenki: Satella mo Tsuiteikimasu!

title.native: 母娘喰い 奪われた媚肉

187932.description:
The master spy Klaus, who boasts a 100 percent mission success rate despite being difficult to work with, has formed the new spy team Lamplight with eight women as his new teammates! Together, no mission is too difficult—or too heinous!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: スパイ教室 4部 燎火
やがて蛸になるきみと
title.romaji: Yagate Tako ni Naru Kimi to

title.native: 竜王に拾われて魔法を極めた少年、追放を言い渡した家族の前でうっかり無双してしまう～兄上たちが僕の仲間を攻撃するなら、徹底的にやり返します～
title.romaji: Ryuuou ni Hirowarete Mahou wo Kiwameta Shounen, Tsuihou wo Iiwatashita Kazoku no Mae de Ukkari Musou Shite Shimau: Aniue-tachi ga Boku no Nakama wo Kougeki Suru Nara, Tetteiteki ni Yarikae Shimasu

187935.description:
There’s an eight-year-old girl in my classroom.

She’s a genius who skipped grades, with an appearance so adorable she’s like a little princess, but her personality is incredibly aloof, and she doesn’t connect with anyone.

I thought the only person she’d open her heart to was her older sister at the same school… but one day, when I gave her some snacks, she suddenly got super attached to me!?

This unexpectedly lonely genius princess starts acting incredibly sweet only toward me. Her affection knows no bounds, and she even tries to make me her stepbrother by getting me to marry her sister, the most beautiful girl in the academy—!?

This is the story of a lonely genius little girl and an ordinary boy you could find anywhere.

(Source: GA Bunko, translated)
synonyms: The Reason Why the Genius Little Girl Who Skips Grades and Won't Warm Up to Anyone Else Only Acts Affectionate Toward Me

title.native: 誰にも懐かない飛び級天才幼女が、俺にだけ甘えてくる理由
title.romaji: Dare ni mo Natsukanai Tobikyuu Tensai Youjo ga, Ore ni dake Amaete Kuru Riyuu

title.native: 反転勇者の逆転英雄譚～「無能はいらん」と追放されたので無能だけでパーティー組んで魔王を討伐します～
title.romaji: Hanten Yuusha no Gyakuten Eiyuutan: "Munou wa Iran" to Tsuihou Sareta Node Munou dake de Party Kunde Maou wo Toubatsu Shimasu

187938.description:
Unlike her younger sister, who is known as the Saint, Finne is rather unremarkable, and has been treated poorly at home. After being sent to a dangerous battlefield as a military doctor, Finne meets a critically injured duke knight named Leon and uses her healing magic to save him from the verge of death. Then, everything in her life starts to change dramatically…?!

(Source: K Manga)

title.english: The Battlefield Saint: I Was Made to Marry a Duke Knight in Place of My Little Sister, but I've since Found Happiness
title.native: 戦場の聖女〜妹の代わりに公爵騎士に嫁ぐことになりましたが、今は幸せです〜
title.romaji: Senjou no Seijo: imouto no Kawari ni Koushaku Kishi ni Totsugu Koto ni Narimashita ga, Ima wa Shiawase desu

187939.description:
Chisato is a hard-working woman in the Administrative Department, who has a new worry in the form of Yoomi-kun, a junior colleague who has just joined her company. They were childhood friends, and now they work at the same company, but as regular co-workers. Yoomi isn't like the cute kid she used to know anymore. He always has a serious attitude at work, so it seems better to act like they don't know each other. But at his welcome party, he started talking about their past history together! Chisato tries to shut up the drunken Yōomi by taking him outside, but when he whispers “Chi-chan,” her old nickname, she can't stop her heart from pounding! Furthermore, Yoomi is smiling like the angelic little boy he once was, as he hugs her and says, “I won't tell anyone, so let me spoil you now."

A chance reunion, and his feelings for the older girl are overflowing…

(Source: Love Chocolat, translated)

title.native: 内緒にするから甘えさせて～そっけない年下の臣くんは私にだけ雄み強め
title.romaji: Naishonisuru kara Amaesasete: Sokkenai Toshishita no Shin-kun wa Watashi ni Dake wo Mi Tsuyome

187943.description:
The phototaxis of living creatures — their instinctive response to light.

After the death of Chairman Jeong Ilhwan of DS Group, the only one left by his side is his cherished young omega lover, Yu Cha-Yeon. Determined to seize full control of the organization, Choi Tae-Mu decides that taking even Jeong’s bonded partner as his own will solidify his power. But Cha-Yeon isn’t what the rumors promised. Far from the mute seductress people describe, he seems strangely innocent—soft in a way Tae-Mu can’t quite understand. And when Cha-Yeon’s heat cycle begins, Tae-Mu gives in to impulse…and sets their fates on a dangerous course.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: [Mr. Blue BL Short Stories] Dogism: Phototaxis

187944.description:
Every night, Yeo-Un takes the last train home—same route, same time, same routine. But one thing keeps catching his eye: a girl with a guitar and a presence that lingers in his mind. When a shared love for the indie band Long Afternoon sparks a conversation, their late-night encounters begin to turn into something more. But Hae-In isn’t just another fan—she’s the voice behind the band, a secret she can’t afford to reveal. As music draws them closer, the truth may threaten to pull them apart. When the final note plays, will their story end in harmony… or heartbreak?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: Mi bias toma el último tren

title.english: My Bias Gets on the Last Train

title.native: 大○透の自然おもしろ生きロボ図鑑
title.romaji: Dai○tou no Shizen Omoshiro Iki Robo Zukan

title.native: 先生！！テスト中に不謹慎です
囚われた人妻捜査官 祐美子 母娘奴隷・黒い淫獄
title.romaji: Torawareta Hitozuma Sousakan Yumiko Oyako Dorei: Kuroi Ingoku

187949.description:
A young, arrogant rich guy meets a poor, average-Joe office worker in this cakeverse series!

In this world, there are people who are "cakes" and people who are "forks." Forks are usually blessed with beauty and talent, but lose their sense of taste at one point in their life. After that point, the only thing these forks can taste are the bodily fluids produced by cakes... One day, Hiroto Ochi is invited to a networking party, where he hopes to rebuild his family business that's going under. There, he meets the standoffish but attractive wealthy young man, Izuru Taishaku. When Izuru accidentally takes a swig of Hiroto's wine, he suddenly starts making out with Hiroto. As Izuru "devours" Hiroto, Hiroto can't help but notice how good it feels...!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: Lick Me, Bite Me, Kiss Me
title.native: 舐めて、噛んで、キスをして

187950.description:
For her sister's happiness and happy ending, Charlotte decides to bring home the knight who holds her sister's heart. However, that means getting to the Black Dragon Order, where the mysterious Archduke Ludovika lurks. As she’s burned at the stake, Rinette makes a desperate wish for another chance…and wakes up as her younger self. Determined to change her fate, she vows to stop Kanna’s schemes and protect her family this time around. But rewriting the past is far from simple. Each choice she makes brings unforeseen consequences—some more devastating than she could imagine. Can Rinette escape the shadows of her past, or will they consume her once more?

When Haruka fails to live up to Kosei's expectations yet again, he has had enough and wants to break up! Seemingly apathetic, Haruka agrees. Despite his frustrations, Kosei loves the small things Haruka does for him, but the small misunderstandings between them have left Kosei feeling broken. A bittersweet love filled with heartbreak as these two try to understand each other. This bittersweet romance explores the heartbreak and challenges of two people in love trying to truly understand each other.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

187994.description:
One snowy winter evening, Chang-Deok spots a high schooler crouched in front of his favorite restaurant, blood running ice-cold in the falling snow. Lured in by the promise of meal made just like the restaurant's, Chang-Deok ends up inviting the boy—Jong-U—into his home; after all, Chang-Deok's life is as dry as day-old rice, and food is his only joy. This is the story of two young people who risk their lives for laughter and fight to navigate the rough seas of talent and tradition.
